20.37.d: दिवो ऽसि निर्मथितं पृथिव्या अध्य् उद्भृतम् । समुद्राद् उच्यसे जातम् अक्ष्यामयभेषजम् अस्य् आथर्वणम् ॥

20.37.s: pūṣā parastād ā vartayatu catasro bhūmyā diśaḥ | sagalika puṣalika punar no naṣṭam āyati jīvena bhunajāmahai ||
20.37.d: पूषा परस्ताद् आ वर्तयतु चतस्रो भूम्या दिशः । सगलिक पुषलिक पुनर् नो नष्टम् आयति जीवेन भुनजामहै ॥

20.37.s: yad ābharac chṛtad agnis tejane naṣṭavedanam | khargaleva punar dattaṃ punar asmā aśvinā naṣṭam ājatam ||
20.37.d: यद् आभरच् छृतद् अग्निस् तेजने नष्टवेदनम् । खर्गलेव पुनर् दत्तं पुनर् अस्मा अश्विना नष्टम् आजतम् ॥
20.37.m:
What Agni brought forth
in the shaft, the finding of the lost—
like a khargalā, give it back;
bring back the lost to this man, O Aśvins!

20.38.s: yady asy apriyajā yadi vānyata ābhṛtaḥ | visalpakasya bheṣajīr devīr āpa imā mama ||
20.38.d: यद्य् अस्य् अप्रियजा यदि वान्यत आभृतः । विसल्पकस्य भेषजीर् देवीर् आप इमा मम ॥
20.38.m:
Whether you are born of an unpleasant thing,
or brought from elsewhere,
these divine waters of mine
are the healers of the visalpaka.

20.38.s: yavasya pūtikasya dṛśāmbasyota garmutaḥ | teṣāṃ sam agrabhaṃ śuṣmam āśūnāṃ dhāvatām iva ||
20.38.d: यवस्य पूतिकस्य दृशाम्बस्योत गर्मुतः । तेषां सम् अग्रभं शुष्मम् आशूनां धावताम् इव ॥
20.38.m:
Of barley, of pūtika,
of dṛśāmba, and of garmut grass—
I have seized their strength,
like that of swift runners.

20.38.s: yas tanuḥ praturvaṇī vadha iva prasarpati | mayūraḥ kila te viṣaṃ kṛkavākuś ca jakṣatu ||
20.38.d: यस् तनुः प्रतुर्वणी वध इव प्रसर्पति । मयूरः किल ते विषं कृकवाकुश् च जक्षतु ॥
20.38.m: The slender, forward-hastening one / creeps forth like a weapon. / Verily let the peacock / and the cock eat up your poison!

20.38.s: udīcīnaḥ pra tanoti nitatnir bhūmyām adhi | ojmānaṃ paśya vīrudho mithunā sam avīvanat ||
20.38.d: उदीचीनः प्र तनोति नितत्निर् भूम्याम् अधि । ओज्मानं पश्य वीरुधो मिथुना सम् अवीवनत् ॥
20.38.m: Turning northwards stretches forth / the downward-creeping plant upon the earth. / Behold the might of the herb! / It has united the pairs.

20.38.s: ni tvātanaṃ nitatninā pari tvāgāṃ sahīyasā | śyenād abhidravīyasā suparṇān nikarīyasā ||
20.38.d: नि त्वातनं नितत्निना परि त्वागां सहीयसा । श्येनाद् अभिद्रवीयसा सुपर्णान् निकरीयसा ॥
20.38.m: I have brought down your tension with the downward-creeping one, / I have encompassed you with a stronger one— / swifter in attack than a falcon, / swooping down lower than an eagle.

20.38.s: yad atrāpi madhor ahaṃ niraṣṭhaviṣam asmṛtam | agniś ca tat savitā ca punar me jaṭhare dhattām ||
20.38.d: यद् अत्रापि मधोर् अहं निरष्ठविषम् अस्मृतम् । अग्निश् च तत् सविता च पुनर् मे जठरे धत्ताम् ॥
20.38.m: What of the sweet drink here / I spat out unremembered, / let both Agni and Savitṛ / place that back in my belly!

20.38.s: agne rudrasya jāyāsi duhitāsi prajāpateḥ | uccaiḥśloke dānapatni haviḥśrava upa tvā hvaya upa mā hvayasva | nariṣṭā nāma vā asi ||
20.38.d: अग्ने रुद्रस्य जायासि दुहितासि प्रजापतेः । उच्चैःश्लोके दानपत्नि हविःश्रव उप त्वा ह्वय उप मा ह्वयस्व । नरिष्टा नाम वा असि ॥
20.38.m: O Agni, you are Rudra's wife, / you are Prajāpati's daughter. / O far-renowned, generous lady, famed for oblation, / I call upon you; call upon me! / Truly you are named Nariṣṭā.

20.38.s: yathāsau hariṇo vṛṣā kūlād adhi praskandati | evā ni ṣkanda pitryād bhagaṃ jayantī dhanaṃ jayantī ||
20.38.d: यथासौ हरिणो वृषा कूलाद् अधि प्रस्कन्दति । एवा नि ष्कन्द पित्र्याद् भगं जयन्ती धनं जयन्ती ॥
20.38.m: Just as that buck deer / leaps down from the bank, / so leap down from what belongs to the father, / winning fortune, winning wealth!

20.38.s: ṛjiśvā mahyam abravīd gandharvasyānuśāsanam | etat te pativedanam ||
20.38.d: ऋजिश्वा मह्यम् अब्रवीद् गन्धर्वस्यानुशासनम् । एतत् ते पतिवेदनम् ॥
20.38.m: Ṛjiśvan declared to me / the instruction of the Gandharva: / this is your husband-finder.

20.38.s: pāṭā bhinattu kumbhaṃ pāṭā kumbhīṃ gadohanīm | pāṭā sarvasya pātrasya vadhūṃ kṛṇotu viśvataḥ ||
20.38.d: पाटा भिनत्तु कुम्भं पाटा कुम्भीं गदोहनीम् । पाटा सर्वस्य पात्रस्य वधूं कृणोतु विश्वतः ॥
20.38.m: Let the pāṭā plant break the jar; / let the pāṭā break the milk-pail pot; / let the pāṭā make the bride / [faultless] all around every vessel.

20.39.s: apehi takmaṃś cara paro anyam asmad iccha puruṣaṃ kaṃ cid eva | veda te takman pitaraṃ veda mātaram ||
20.39.d: अपेहि तक्मंश् चर परो अन्यम् अस्मद् इच्छ पुरुषं कं चिद् एव । वेद ते तक्मन् पितरं वेद मातरम् ॥
20.39.m: Go away, O fever; wander far away; / seek someone else among men! / I know your father, I know your mother.

20.39.s: śamīvān asi śāmīvataḥ śamīvān ābhiśokiḥ | abhiśoko hārṣaṇir harṣaṇo jāñjabhiḥ ||
20.39.d: शमीवान् असि शामीवतः शमीवान् आभिशोकिः । अभिशोको हार्षणिर् हर्षणो जाञ्जभिः ॥
20.39.m: You are endowed with śamī, offspring of Śamīvant; / you are endowed with śamī, son of Abhiśoka. / Abhiśoka is the son of Harṣaṇa; / Harṣaṇa is the son of Jāñjabhi.

20.39.s: yaḥ paśūnāṃ mārjanīyo yaṃ tvam aṃśena bhejiṣe | abhīhi takman gardabhaṃ na mām abhyetum arhasi ||
20.39.d: यः पशूनां मार्जनीयो यं त्वम् अंशेन भेजिषे । अभीहि तक्मन् गर्दभं न माम् अभ्येतुम् अर्हसि ॥
20.39.m: He who is the cleansing-rag among the beasts, / whom you have received as your share— / go to the donkey, O fever! / You should not come to me.

20.39.s: visrasā nāma te mātā kiḥkiśo nāma te pitā | śimidā nāma te svasā ||
20.39.d: विस्रसा नाम ते माता किःकिशो नाम ते पिता । शिमिदा नाम ते स्वसा ॥
20.39.m: Visrasā is your mother's name; / Kiḥkiśa is your father's name; / Śimidā is your sister's name.

20.39.s: giriṃ gaccha girijā asi girau te māhiṣo gṛhaḥ | dāsī cakram āsthāya nāmlāte ni krandayiṣyati ||
20.39.d: गिरिं गच्छ गिरिजा असि गिरौ ते माहिषो गृहः । दासी चक्रम् आस्थाय नाम्लाते नि क्रन्दयिष्यति ॥
20.39.m: Go to the mountain; you are mountain-born; / on the mountain is your buffalo home. / Mounting the wheel, the slave woman / will cause [you] to cry out on the unwithering one.

20.39.s: ā vāto vātv anaghaḥ sarvasya dūto abhiśastipāḥ | jalāṣam it pra siñcati tad viṣasyāpa siñcatu ||
20.39.d: आ वातो वात्व् अनघः सर्वस्य दूतो अभिशस्तिपाः । जलाषम् इत् प्र सिञ्चति तद् विषस्याप सिञ्चतु ॥
20.39.m: Let the wind blow sinless, / messenger of all, protector against curses. / Truly it pours forth jalāṣa; / let it pour that away from the poison!

20.39.s: yām asyati pṛśnibāhur iṣṭaṃ haridruparṇyam | tām asya niṣ khidāmasi yathā jīvāsi bhadrayā ||
20.39.d: याम् अस्यति पृश्निबाहुर् इष्टं हरिद्रुपर्ण्यम् । ताम् अस्य निष् खिदामसि यथा जीवासि भद्रया ॥
20.39.m: The desired [arrow] with yellow-tree leaves / that the speckled-armed one shoots— / that of his we pull out, / so that you may live happily.

20.39.s: aśrāntasya tvā manasā yunajmi prathamasya ca | utkūlam udvaho bhav oduhya prati dhāvatāt ||
20.39.d: अश्रान्तस्य त्वा मनसा युनज्मि प्रथमस्य च । उत्कूलम् उद्वहो भव् ओदुह्य प्रति धावतात् ॥
20.39.m: With the mind of the unwearied one / and of the foremost one I yoke you. / Bear up the slope! / Having borne [it] up, run toward [us]!

20.39.s: etaṃ dantaṃ nirṛtyā ghoram āhur yasta āsann avarūḍha eṣaḥ | taṃ durhārde pra hiṇomi ghoraṃ sa no mā hiṃsīj jyāyaso mā kanīyasaḥ ||
20.39.d: एतं दन्तं निरृत्या घोरम् आहुर् यस्त आसन्न् अवरूढ एषः । तं दुर्हार्दे प्र हिणोमि घोरं स नो मा हिंसीज् ज्यायसो मा कनीयसः ॥
20.39.m: This tooth they call dreadful, of Nirṛti, / which has descended in your mouth. / That dreadful one I send away to the ill-hearted— / not of our elder, nor of our younger!

20.39.s: śivaḥ śagmo bhavatu danta eṣa mā no hiṃsīj jyāyaso mā kanīyasaḥ | aghamāram aghaśaṃsaṃ nirṛthaṃ taṃ te dantaḥ sacatāṃ ghora eṣaḥ ||
20.39.d: शिवः शग्मो भवतु दन्त एष मा नो हिंसीज् ज्यायसो मा कनीयसः । अघमारम् अघशंसं निरृथं तं ते दन्तः सचतां घोर एषः ॥
20.39.m:
Kindly and powerful let this tooth be; / let it not harm our elder nor our younger! / To the deadly pestilence, the evil-speaking, the ruin, / to that let this dreadful tooth of yours attach itself!

To the deadly pestilence, the evil-speaking, the ruin, / to the ill-hearted I send away the dreadful tooth. / Let it consume his two-footed and four-footed [creatures]; / let it be kindly, well-disposed to us!

20.40.s: aghamāram aghaśaṃsaṃ nirṛthaṃ durhārde dantaṃ pra hiṇomi ghoram | so asyāttu dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ śivo asmabhyaṃ sumanā astv eṣaḥ ||
20.40.d: अघमारम् अघशंसं निरृथं दुर्हार्दे दन्तं प्र हिणोमि घोरम् । सो अस्यात्तु द्विपदश् चतुष्पदः शिवो अस्मभ्यं सुमना अस्त्व् एषः ॥

20.40.s: śivaṃ te dantaṃ haviṣā kṛṇomi śivo mahyaṃ kurvate danto astu | śivāni te trīṇi trikadrukāṇi santu śivo mahyaṃ nabhasī rodasī stām ||
20.40.d: शिवं ते दन्तं हविषा कृणोमि शिवो मह्यं कुर्वते दन्तो अस्तु । शिवानि ते त्रीणि त्रिकद्रुकाणि सन्तु शिवो मह्यं नभसी रोदसी स्ताम् ॥
20.40.m: Kindly I make your tooth with the oblation; / kindly let the tooth be to me who acts. / Kindly let your three trikadruka days be; / kindly to me let the two realms of sky and earth be!

20.40.s: pururūpā pṛthupeśā araṃkṛd vahator asi | pratiṣṭhāsi catuṣpadāṃ yas ta eṣa pañcamaḥ pādas taṃ tena prati gṛhṇāmi ||
20.40.d: पुरुरूपा पृथुपेशा अरंकृद् वहतोर् असि । प्रतिष्ठासि चतुष्पदां यस् त एष पञ्चमः पादस् तं तेन प्रति गृह्णामि ॥
20.40.m: Of many forms, broadly adorned, / you are the preparer of the bridal procession. / You are the support of the four-footed. / This fifth foot that is yours, / with that I receive it.

20.40.s: sasarparīr amatiṃ bādhamānā bṛhan mimāya jamadagnidattā | ā sūryasya duhitā tatāna śravo deveṣv amṛtam ajuryam ||
20.40.d: ससर्परीर् अमतिं बाधमाना बृहन् मिमाय जमदग्निदत्ता । आ सूर्यस्य दुहिता ततान श्रवो देवेष्व् अमृतम् अजुर्यम् ॥
20.40.m: Sasarparī, repelling destitution, / roared loudly, given by Jamadagni. / The daughter of the sun stretched forth / imperishable, unaging fame among the gods.

20.40.s: sasarparīr abharat tūyam ebhyo 'dhi śravaḥ pāñcajanyāsu kṛṣṭiṣu | sā pakṣyā navyamāyur dadhānā yāṃ me pulasti jamadagnayo daduḥ ||
20.40.d: ससर्परीर् अभरत् तूयम् एभ्यो ऽधि श्रवः पाञ्चजन्यासु कृष्टिषु । सा पक्ष्या नव्यमायुर् दधाना यां मे पुलस्ति जमदग्नयो ददुः ॥
20.40.m: Sasarparī swiftly brought fame / from them over the five races of men— / she, bearing wings, / whom the Jamadagnis with forward-stretched hands gave to me.

20.40.s: aghnye dūramūt kanda ni padaś caturo jahi | adhā goduhaḥ śīrṣaṇi śaphām̐ urasi vādaya ||
20.40.d: अघ्न्ये दूरमूत् कन्द नि पदश् चतुरो जहि । अधा गोदुहः शीर्षणि शफाँ उरसि वादय ॥
20.40.m: O cow that must not be slain, leap from afar; / strike down with all four feet! / Then on the cow-milker's head, / on his chest make your hooves resound!

20.40.s: śṛṅgābhyām upa sraṣṭāraṃ padāvartaya goduham | atho ye anye tiṣṭhanti tān viṣūco vi nāśaya ||
20.40.d: शृङ्गाभ्याम् उप स्रष्टारं पदावर्तय गोदुहम् । अथो ये अन्ये तिष्ठन्ति तान् विषूचो वि नाशय ॥
20.40.m: With your horns toss the milk-pourer; / with your foot turn back the cow-milker! / And whoever else stands by, / scatter them apart in all directions!

20.40.s: yathā nartā sakṣikājiṃ ni kulpham abhinṛtyati | evā tvam aghnye padaḥ sarvān sākam ud ardaya ||
20.40.d: यथा नर्ता सक्षिकाजिं नि कुल्फम् अभिनृत्यति । एवा त्वम् अघ्न्ये पदः सर्वान् साकम् उद् अर्दय ॥
20.40.m: Just as a dancer tramples down / the ankle in the dance-contest, / so do you, O cow that must not be slain, / shake up all your feet together!

20.40.s: ud u kṣīram uttabhitaṃ syandantām asya dhenavaḥ | asṛk tasya gāvo duhrāṃ yo asmān nāpacāyati ||
20.40.d: उद् उ क्षीरम् उत्तभितं स्यन्दन्ताम् अस्य धेनवः । असृक् तस्य गावो दुह्रां यो अस्मान् नापचायति ॥
20.40.m: High up held fast be the milk; / let his milch cows flow away! / Let the cows of him who [hates] us / yield blood!

20.40.s: ṛkṣīkāyā yathā mano vyāghrasya yathā manaḥ | evā tasya gavāṃ mano yo asmān nāpacāyati ||
20.40.d: ऋक्षीकाया यथा मनो व्याघ्रस्य यथा मनः । एवा तस्य गवां मनो यो अस्मान् नापचायति ॥
20.40.m: As the mind of a she-bear, / as the mind of a tiger, / so [be] the mind of the cows of him / who [hates] us!

20.41.s: uttamosy oṣadhīnāṃ vīrudhāṃ balavattamaḥ | sasyandana tvam oṣadhe sarvāḥ syandaya gā imāḥ ||
20.41.d: उत्तमोस्य् ओषधीनां वीरुधां बलवत्तमः । सस्यन्दन त्वम् ओषधे सर्वाः स्यन्दय गा इमाः ॥
20.41.m: You are the highest of the plants, / the strongest of the herbs. / You, O streaming plant, / cause these cows to stream!

20.41.s: aranturathantu | vaneṣu śuṣmo astu te pṛthivyām astu yad dharaḥ ||
20.41.d: अरन्तुरथन्तु । वनेषु शुष्मो अस्तु ते पृथिव्याम् अस्तु यद् धरः ॥
20.41.m: Arantu, Athantu... / Let your wrath be in the woods; / let whatever heat [you have] be on the earth!

20.41.s: akṛd aśvo akṛt kharo akṛd aśvataro hariḥ | evāsi bahvaghe tava bhasan nadatv āsicā ||
20.41.d: अकृद् अश्वो अकृत् खरो अकृद् अश्वतरो हरिः । एवासि बह्वघे तव भसन् नदत्व् आसिचा ॥
20.41.m: The horse has performed, the donkey has performed, / the tawny mule has performed. / Thus you are of many evils; / let your rump resound with the pourer!

20.41.s: yathā nadati gardabha evā nadati te bhasat | vrīher yavasya māṣasy aitat paśyābhidarśanam ||
20.41.d: यथा नदति गर्दभ एवा नदति ते भसत् । व्रीहेर् यवस्य माषस्य् ऐतत् पश्याभिदर्शनम् ॥
20.41.m: Just as a donkey brays, / so does your rump resound. / Of rice, of barley, of kidney-beans— / behold this manifestation!

20.41.s: ud bhare dyāvāpṛthivī ud āpa ud agnim ud indram ut sūryam ud rātrim ud ahaḥ ||
20.41.d: उद् भरे द्यावापृथिवी उद् आप उद् अग्निम् उद् इन्द्रम् उत् सूर्यम् उद् रात्रिम् उद् अहः ॥
20.41.m: I lift up heaven and earth; / I lift up the waters, I lift up Agni, I lift up Indra, / I lift up Sūrya, I lift up the night, I lift up the day!

20.41.s: namaskṛtya dyāvāpṛthivībhyām antarikṣāya mṛtyave | mekṣyāmy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan mā mā hiṃsiṣur īśvarāḥ ||
20.41.d: नमस्कृत्य द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् अन्तरिक्षाय मृत्यवे । मेक्ष्याम्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् मा मा हिंसिषुर् ईश्वराः ॥
20.41.m: Having paid homage to heaven and earth, / to the intermediate space, to death, / I shall urinate standing upright; / let the rulers not harm me!

20.41.s: yan meḍhvā yad apsarasaḥ payo devīr ahṛṣata | tad ihopa hṛyāmahe cakṣuṣe ca balāya ca | devānāṃ devahūtyā mayi tyā devatāḥ punaḥ ||
20.41.d: यन् मेढ्वा यद् अप्सरसः पयो देवीर् अहृषत । तद् इहोप हृयामहे चक्षुषे च बलाय च । देवानां देवहूत्या मयि त्या देवताः पुनः ॥
20.41.m: Whatever milk the Apsarases, / the divine ladies, took away, / that here we bring back / for sight and for strength. / Through the invocation of the gods, / let those deities [abide] again in me!

20.41.s: yāsya doṣā rasasya me tvaṃ devi tatarpitha | nārāśaṃsena stomen āhaṃ tvat punar ā dade yuṣmad apsarasas pari ||
20.41.d: यास्य दोषा रसस्य मे त्वं देवि ततर्पिथ । नाराशंसेन स्तोमेन् आहं त्वत् पुनर् आ ददे युष्मद् अप्सरसस् परि ॥
20.41.m: With which sap of mine in the evening / you, O goddess, were gratified, / with the nārāśaṃsa hymn / I take it back from you, / away from you Apsarases!

20.41.s: yan me tanvo rasaṃ vayam ud apsarasas pari | nārāśaṃsena stomena prajām ā pyāyāmahe ||
20.41.d: यन् मे तन्वो रसं वयम् उद् अप्सरसस् परि । नाराशंसेन स्तोमेन प्रजाम् आ प्यायामहे ॥
20.41.m: The sap of my body that [they took], / we, away from the Apsarases, / with the nārāśaṃsa hymn, / cause our progeny to swell.

20.41.s: yan me payo viṣiṣice jāgrataḥ svapataś ca yat | punas tad adya me devā ā siñcantu tanū adhi ||
20.41.d: यन् मे पयो विषिषिचे जाग्रतः स्वपतश् च यत् । पुनस् तद् अद्य मे देवा आ सिञ्चन्तु तनू अधि ॥
20.41.m: What milk of mine has been spilled out, / of me awake and of me asleep, / let the gods today pour that back / upon my body!

20.42.s: yad adya dugdhaṃ pṛthivīm asakta yad oṣadhīr vyasarad yad āpaḥ | vatse payo gavi payo yad asyām asmāṃs tat sacatāṃ payaḥ ||
20.42.d: यद् अद्य दुग्धं पृथिवीम् असक्त यद् ओषधीर् व्यसरद् यद् आपः । वत्से पयो गवि पयो यद् अस्याम् अस्मांस् तत् सचतां पयः ॥
20.42.m: What milked [liquid] today touched the earth, / what dispersed into the plants, what into the waters— / what milk was in the calf, what milk in the cow, / let that milk adhere [to us]!

20.42.s: parā patanty āśavo 'śvā adhodhuraṃ yathā | evā mūtra pra bhidyasva vi vaster āsyaṃ sṛja ||
20.42.d: परा पतन्त्य् आशवो ऽश्वा अधोधुरं यथा । एवा मूत्र प्र भिद्यस्व वि वस्तेर् आस्यं सृज ॥
20.42.m: The swift horses fly forth / as if beneath the yoke. / Even so, O urine, burst open; / release the mouth of the bladder!
"Untied is the orifice of your bladder" is one [verse].

20.42.s: asya pāre samudrasya śukraṃ jyotir amartyam | tan naḥ pātv aṃhasas tan naḥ pātu viśvataḥ ||
20.42.d: अस्य पारे समुद्रस्य शुक्रं ज्योतिर् अमर्त्यम् । तन् नः पात्व् अंहसस् तन् नः पातु विश्वतः ॥
20.42.m: On the further shore of this ocean / is the bright, immortal light; / let that protect us from distress, / let that protect us from every side!

20.42.s: ā no medhā sumatir viśvarūpā hiraṇyavarṇā jagatī jagamyāt | sā no agne medhā juṣatām iha pracetāḥ ||
20.42.d: आ नो मेधा सुमतिर् विश्वरूपा हिरण्यवर्णा जगती जगम्यात् । सा नो अग्ने मेधा जुषताम् इह प्रचेताः ॥
20.42.m: May wisdom, the all-formed good thought, / golden-colored, moving, come to us! / May that wisdom, O Agni, / wise, enjoy us here!

20.42.s: niṣ krāmatv iṣiryo atra praviṣṭo vayāṣṭhaś ca sayujā yāv iha staḥ | sapta ṛṣīṇāṃ syūmaraśmiḥ pathaitu svān mṛgān punar apy etu kṛṣṇaḥ ||
20.42.d: निष् क्रामत्व् इषिर्यो अत्र प्रविष्टो वयाष्ठश् च सयुजा याव् इह स्तः । सप्त ऋषीणां स्यूमरश्मिः पथैतु स्वान् मृगान् पुनर् अप्य् एतु कृष्णः ॥
20.42.m: Let the vigorous one go forth who entered here, / and the two of you who are united here! / Let the strap-rayed one go on the path of the seven seers; / let the black one go back to his own wild beasts!

20.42.s: sapta ṛṣīn gaccha syūmaraśmaye mṛgān kṛṣṇaḥ sacatāṃ vājo aśvam | īḍo asmān suprajasaḥ suvīrān saha yajñena payasā sacātai ||
20.42.d: सप्त ऋषीन् गच्छ स्यूमरश्मये मृगान् कृष्णः सचतां वाजो अश्वम् । ईडो अस्मान् सुप्रजसः सुवीरान् सह यज्ञेन पयसा सचातै ॥
20.42.m: Go to the seven seers, O strap-rayed one; / let the black one attach himself to the wild beasts, the steed to the horse! / May Praise accompany us, blessed with good offspring, with good sons, / together with the sacrifice and with milk!

20.42.s: namo astv ṛṣaye syūmaraśmaye namaḥ kṛṣṇāyota yo vājo asya | namo devāyārvateṣu jiṣṇave 'yaṃ no vājī pra tirāty āyuḥ ||
20.42.d: नमो अस्त्व् ऋषये स्यूमरश्मये नमः कृष्णायोत यो वाजो अस्य । नमो देवायार्वतेषु जिष्णवे ऽयं नो वाजी प्र तिरात्य् आयुः ॥
20.42.m: Homage be to the strap-rayed one; / homage to the black one and to what is his speed! / Homage to the divine one, victorious among the coursers; / may this swift steed lengthen our lifespan!

20.42.s: ati yanty ahāny ati rātrīr aty uṣasaḥ | āpo antardhāvarīs tābhir antar dadhe tvā ||
20.42.d: अति यन्त्य् अहान्य् अति रात्रीर् अत्य् उषसः । आपो अन्तर्धावरीस् ताभिर् अन्तर् दधे त्वा ॥
20.42.m: The days pass by, the nights pass by, the dawns pass by. / The waters are concealing; with them I conceal you.

20.42.s: yathā naidāghye māsi bahvīḥ śuṣyanty oṣadhīḥ | evā pra śuṣya mām anu yac ca paśyāmi yac ca na ||
20.42.d: यथा नैदाघ्ये मासि बह्वीः शुष्यन्त्य् ओषधीः । एवा प्र शुष्य माम् अनु यच् च पश्यामि यच् च न ॥
20.42.m: Just as in the summer month / many plants dry up, / so dry up after me, / both what I see and what [I do] not!

20.42.s: pāṭā bibharty aṅkuśaṃ hiraṇyavantam aṅkinam | tenāham anyeṣāṃ striya ā lumpāmi mamed asan ||
20.42.d: पाटा बिभर्त्य् अङ्कुशं हिरण्यवन्तम् अङ्किनम् । तेनाहम् अन्येषां स्त्रिय आ लुम्पामि ममेद् असन् ॥
20.42.m: Pāṭā bears a hook, / golden and barbed; / with it I seize / the women of others for myself alone.

20.43.s: indra jīva sūrya jīva devā jīvā jīvyāsam aham | sarvam āyur jīvyāsam ||
20.43.d: इन्द्र जीव सूर्य जीव देवा जीवा जीव्यासम् अहम् । सर्वम् आयुर् जीव्यासम् ॥
20.43.m: Live, O Indra! Live, O Sūrya! / O gods, living ones, may I live! / May I live a full lifespan!

20.43.s: anābhūr asmi naitave tantyāṃ baddho divi śritaḥ | āhā tvā nirṛtaye ||
20.43.d: अनाभूर् अस्मि नैतवे तन्त्यां बद्धो दिवि श्रितः । आहा त्वा निरृतये ॥
20.43.m: Bound to the rope, resting in heaven, / I am not to go [away]. / I have spoken you to Nirṛti.

20.43.s: rantir asi ramatir asi | saṃ śrutena rādhiṣīya mā śrutena vi rādhiṣi ||
20.43.d: रन्तिर् असि रमतिर् असि । सं श्रुतेन राधिषीय मा श्रुतेन वि राधिषि ॥
20.43.m: Pleasure you are, resting-place you are. / May I succeed through what is heard; / may I not be deprived of what is heard!

20.43.s: darśo 'si darśato 'si viśvataḥ saṃdṛṣṭaḥ | somo asi rudro asi ||
20.43.d: दर्शो ऽसि दर्शतो ऽसि विश्वतः संदृष्टः । सोमो असि रुद्रो असि ॥
20.43.m: New moon you are, visible you are, / perceived from all sides. / Soma you are, Rudra you are.

20.43.s: taṃ tvā yaṃ devā aṃśum āpyāyanti taṃ tvā yam ādityā aṃśum āpyāyanti | taṃ tvā yam akṣitam akṣitaye pibanti sa naḥ somaḥ pra tirad dīrgham āyuḥ ||
20.43.d: तं त्वा यं देवा अंशुम् आप्यायन्ति तं त्वा यम् आदित्या अंशुम् आप्यायन्ति । तं त्वा यम् अक्षितम् अक्षितये पिबन्ति स नः सोमः प्र तिरद् दीर्घम् आयुः ॥
20.43.m: That shoot which the gods cause to swell, / that shoot which the Ādityas cause to swell, / which, inexhaustible, they drink for inexhaustibility, / may that Soma prolong our long life!

20.43.s: anyeṣāṃ prāṇenā pyāyasva māsmākaṃ prāṇena | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tasya prāṇenā pyāyasva ||
20.43.d: अन्येषां प्राणेना प्यायस्व मास्माकं प्राणेन । यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस् तस्य प्राणेना प्यायस्व ॥
20.43.m: Swell with the breath of others, / not with our breath! / He who hates us, whom we hate— / swell with his breath!

20.43.s: cid asi samudrayoniḥ śyena ṛtāvān | somapīthopa na ehy arvāṅ rāyaspoṣeṇa prajayā dhanena ||
20.43.d: चिद् असि समुद्रयोनिः श्येन ऋतावान् । सोमपीथोप न एह्य् अर्वाङ् रायस्पोषेण प्रजया धनेन ॥
20.43.m: You are thought, born of the ocean, a falcon possessing truth. / Come near to us hither for the drinking of Soma, / with increase of wealth, with offspring, with property!

20.43.s: svarava stha namo vo mahatām ūrjāyai | parṇāṃ māva gām ||
20.43.d: स्वरव स्थ नमो वो महताम् ऊर्जायै । पर्णां माव गाम् ॥
20.43.m: You are chips of sacrificial post; homage be to your vigor of the great ones! / May I not fall down [like] a leaf!

20.43.s: apaścāddaghvānnasya bhūyāsam | annādāyānnapataye rudrāya namo agnaye ||
20.43.d: अपश्चाद्दघ्वान्नस्य भूयासम् । अन्नादायान्नपतये रुद्राय नमो अग्नये ॥
20.43.m: May I be [so]! / Homage to Agni, the eater of food, the lord of food, to Rudra!

20.43.s: yā te vaso vāta iṣuḥ sā ta eṣā | tayā no mṛḍa ||
20.43.d: या ते वसो वात इषुः सा त एषा । तया नो मृड ॥
20.43.m: That arrow of yours, O good wind, which is yours, / with that be gracious to us!

20.44.s: agnis takmānam apa bādhatām ito varuṇo grāvā marutaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ | barhiṣadaḥ samidhaḥ śośucānās takmanaḥ śocām apa nir nudantu ||
20.44.d: अग्निस् तक्मानम् अप बाधताम् इतो वरुणो ग्रावा मरुतः पूतदक्षाः । बर्हिषदः समिधः शोशुचानास् तक्मनः शोचाम् अप निर् नुदन्तु ॥
20.44.m: Let Agni repel the fever from here, / and Varuṇa, the pressing-stone, the Maruts of purified skill! / Sitting on the sacrificial grass, glowing bright, let the firewood sticks / thrust away the burning heat of the fever!

20.44.s: yo abhyavabhṛṇāyasi svapantam iccha puruṣaṃ śayānam akovidam | sa naḥ sahasravīry ānuṣṭhātā śivo bhava ||
20.44.d: यो अभ्यवभृणायसि स्वपन्तम् इच्छ पुरुषं शयानम् अकोविदम् । स नः सहस्रवीर्य् आनुष्ठाता शिवो भव ॥
20.44.m: You who act like an oblation, / seek a sleeping man, / one who is lying down, unaware! / So, [O plant] of thousandfold power, / performer of deeds, be auspicious to us!

20.44.s: devayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
20.44.d: देवयातुर् असि मृडो ऽसि । मृडास्माकं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे मा तस्य मीमृडो द्विपदे चतुष्पदे यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
20.44.m: You are a sorcerer of gods, you are gracious. / Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed [creatures]; / do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed [creatures] of him / who hates us, whom we hate!

20.44.s: brahmayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
20.44.d: ब्रह्मयातुर् असि मृडो ऽसि । मृडास्माकं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे मा तस्य मीमृडो द्विपदे चतुष्पदे यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
20.44.m: You are a sorcerer of sacred speech, you are gracious. / Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed [creatures]; / do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed [creatures] of him / who hates us, whom we hate!

20.44.s: annayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
20.44.d: अन्नयातुर् असि मृडो ऽसि । मृडास्माकं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे मा तस्य मीमृडो द्विपदे चतुष्पदे यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
20.44.m: You are a sorcerer of food, you are gracious. / Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed [creatures]; / do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed [creatures] of him / who hates us, whom we hate!

20.44.s: manuṣyayātur asi mṛḍo 'si | mṛḍāsmākaṃ dvipade catuṣpade mā tasya mīmṛḍo dvipade catuṣpade yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
20.44.d: मनुष्ययातुर् असि मृडो ऽसि । मृडास्माकं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे मा तस्य मीमृडो द्विपदे चतुष्पदे यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
20.44.m: You are a sorcerer of men, you are gracious. / Be gracious to our two-footed and four-footed [creatures]; / do not be gracious to the two-footed and four-footed [creatures] of him / who hates us, whom we hate!

20.44.s: avabharaṇo nāmāsi devatrā ṇo akṣamāpaḥ | yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ ta āsann api daghmaḥ ||
20.44.d: अवभरणो नामासि देवत्रा णो अक्षमापः । यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस् तं त आसन्न् अपि दघ्मः ॥
20.44.m: Avabharaṇa is your name; among the gods you have brought us across. / He who hates us, whom we hate— / him we burn right in your mouth!

20.44.s: yad adosnātā āsuro dīkṣito 'carat | tasya yan malam avāsravat sa hi nāsi tāvad anuṣṭhyā tvā vidma arasaṃ vṛścika te viṣam ||
20.44.d: यद् अदोस्नाता आसुरो दीक्षितो ऽचरत् । तस्य यन् मलम् अवास्रवत् स हि नासि तावद् अनुष्ठ्या त्वा विद्म अरसं वृश्चिक ते विषम् ॥
20.44.m: When the Asura wandered consecrated, / whatever impurity flowed down from him— / you are not that snake; so far we know you: / sapless is your poison, O scorpion!

20.44.s: ketuluṅgā nāma te mātā karkaṭaḥ pitā | tat satyam arasam abhaga te viṣam ||
20.44.d: केतुलुङ्गा नाम ते माता कर्कटः पिता । तत् सत्यम् अरसम् अभग ते विषम् ॥
20.44.m: Ketuluṅgā is your mother's name, crab your father; / that is the truth: sapless is your poison, O unfortunate one!

20.44.s: dve viṣasya dhāre striyā anyā puṃso anyā | te ubhe arase ||
20.44.d: द्वे विषस्य धारे स्त्रिया अन्या पुंसो अन्या । ते उभे अरसे ॥
20.44.m: Two are the streams of poison: one of the female, one of the male; / both of them are sapless.

20.45.s: viśvavit taṃ naṣṭam anu paśyasi | ado me naṣṭaṃ tan me punar dehi ||
20.45.d: विश्ववित् तं नष्टम् अनु पश्यसि । अदो मे नष्टं तन् मे पुनर् देहि ॥
20.45.m: O all-knowing one, you see after that lost item. / Yonder is my lost item: give that back to me!

20.45.s: viśvakarman tat tvam upa gacchasi | ado me naṣṭaṃ tan me punar dehi ||
20.45.d: विश्वकर्मन् तत् त्वम् उप गच्छसि । अदो मे नष्टं तन् मे पुनर् देहि ॥
20.45.m: O Viśvakarman, you approach that. / Yonder is my lost item: give that back to me!

20.45.s: viśvavyacas tat tvayy adhy āhitam | ado me naṣṭaṃ tan me punar dehi ||
20.45.d: विश्वव्यचस् तत् त्वय्य् अध्य् आहितम् । अदो मे नष्टं तन् मे पुनर् देहि ॥
20.45.m: O all-encompassing one, that is placed upon you. / Yonder is my lost item: give that back to me!

20.45.s: pari pūṣā purastād dhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam | punar no naṣṭam āyati jīvena bhunajāmahai ||
20.45.d: परि पूषा पुरस्ताद् धस्तं दधातु दक्षिणम् । पुनर् नो नष्टम् आयति जीवेन भुनजामहै ॥
20.45.m: Let Pūṣan put around / his right hand in front! / Let our lost item return again; / may we enjoy it alive!

20.45.s: indras tvābhy ait sarpat tat tvā goṣṭha ādadhāt | tad āsrāvasya bheṣajaṃ tad u rogam anīnaśat ||
20.45.d: इन्द्रस् त्वाभ्य् ऐत् सर्पत् तत् त्वा गोष्ठ आदधात् । तद् आस्रावस्य भेषजं तद् उ रोगम् अनीनशत् ॥
20.45.m: Indra came upon you as you crawled; / he placed you there in the cow-pen. / That is the medicine for discharge; / that has destroyed the disease.

20.45.s: viṣṇor manasā pūte sthaḥ | devo vāṃ savitot punātu ||
20.45.d: विष्णोर् मनसा पूते स्थः । देवो वां सवितोत् पुनातु ॥
20.45.m: You two are purified by Viṣṇu's mind. / May the divine Savitṛ purify you two!

20.45.s: viṣṇor manasā pūtam asi devas tvā savitot punātu | acchidreṇa pavitreṇa sahasradhāreṇa supvā ||
20.45.d: विष्णोर् मनसा पूतम् असि देवस् त्वा सवितोत् पुनातु । अच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेण सहस्रधारेण सुप्वा ॥
20.45.m: Purified you are by Viṣṇu's mind. / May the divine Savitṛ purify you / with an unslit strainer, / with a thousand streams, well-cleansing!

20.45.s: hṛdā pūtaṃ manasā jātavedo viśvāni devo vayunāni vidvān | saptāsyāni tava yāny agne tebhyo juhomi sa juṣasva havyam ||
20.45.d: हृदा पूतं मनसा जातवेदो विश्वानि देवो वयुनानि विद्वान् । सप्तास्यानि तव यान्य् अग्ने तेभ्यो जुहोमि स जुषस्व हव्यम् ॥
20.45.m: Purified with the heart, with the mind, O Jātavedas, / the god knowing all pathways, / those seven mouths which are yours, O Agni— / to them I sacrifice; enjoy the oblation!

20.45.s: yas te keśām̐ avācīnān krimir vṛhati mūrdhataḥ | prāṇaṃ tasyopa dāśayād vīrut khanati bheṣajī ||
20.45.d: यस् ते केशाँ अवाचीनान् क्रिमिर् वृहति मूर्धतः । प्राणं तस्योप दाशयाद् वीरुत् खनति भेषजी ॥
20.45.m: The worm that plucks out your hair / downward from the head, / may the healing plant which he digs up / destroy its breath!

20.45.s: veda vai te bhaga nāma bhūrir nāmāsi rayir nāma | taṃ tvā bhaga pra viśāmi sa mā bhaga pra viśa | tasmin sahasrakāṇḍena mṛje bhaga tvayi ||
20.45.d: वेद वै ते भग नाम भूरिर् नामासि रयिर् नाम । तं त्वा भग प्र विशामि स मा भग प्र विश । तस्मिन् सहस्रकाण्डेन मृजे भग त्वयि ॥
20.45.m: I know your name, O Bhaga: / Abundant is your name, Wealth is your name. / As such, O Bhaga, I enter into you; / so enter into me, O Bhaga! / With a thousand-jointed [plant] in that, / I wipe myself in you, O Bhaga.

20.46.m: May Vedic students come to me, svāhā!
May I be better than the fortunate ones, svāhā!
Renowned, may I move among people, svāhā!
[A favorite] of gods, of men, / of cattle, of Vedic students—
make me dear to Prajāpati, svāhā!

20.46.s: ayaṃ me hasto akṣito rudati tam u me agadaṃ kṛdhi ||
20.46.d: अयं मे हस्तो अक्षितो रुदति तम् उ मे अगदं कृधि ॥
20.46.m: This hand of mine, unhurt, weeps; / make it free from disease for me!

20.46.s: tvaṃ kṣitsya bheṣajy ubhayor akṣitasya ca ||
20.46.d: त्वं क्षित्स्य भेषज्य् उभयोर् अक्षितस्य च ॥
20.46.m: You are the remedy of the hurt / and of both, [even] of the unhurt.

20.47.s: veda vai te nārada nāma vāg nāmāsi tasya te yaśo bhakṣīya ||
20.47.d: वेद वै ते नारद नाम वाग् नामासि तस्य ते यशो भक्षीय ॥
20.47.m: I know your name, O Nārada: / Speech is your name. / May I partake of that fame of yours!

20.47.s: veda vai te sanāt kumāra nāma cakṣur nāmāsi tasya te madhu bhakṣīya ||
20.47.d: वेद वै ते सनात् कुमार नाम चक्षुर् नामासि तस्य ते मधु भक्षीय ॥
20.47.m: I know your name, O Sanatkumāra: / Sight is your name. / May I partake of that sweetness of yours!

20.48.s: snuṣāsau senāsyāḥ senāyā ihāsyāḥ śvaśuroyam asyāḥ śvaśuraḥ | sā yathā snuṣā śvaśurād adhaspadyate adharā padyate nīcī padyate ||
20.48.d: स्नुषासौ सेनास्याः सेनाया इहास्याः श्वशुरोयम् अस्याः श्वशुरः । सा यथा स्नुषा श्वशुराद् अधस्पद्यते अधरा पद्यते नीची पद्यते ॥
20.48.m: That army is the daughter-in-law of this army; / here is her father-in-law, this one is her father-in-law. / Just as a daughter-in-law falls down before her father-in-law, / falls lower, falls downward,

20.48.s: evāsau senāsyāḥ senāyā adhas padyatām adharā padyatāṃ nīcī padyatām | sendrāgnibhyāṃ hatavīrāṃ hatapūruṣāṃ parājitāṃ praṇuttaitu paramāṃ parāvatam ||
20.48.d: एवासौ सेनास्याः सेनाया अधस् पद्यताम् अधरा पद्यतां नीची पद्यताम् । सेन्द्राग्निभ्यां हतवीरां हतपूरुषां पराजितां प्रणुत्तैतु परमां परावतम् ॥
20.48.m: so let that army fall down before this army, / let it fall lower, let it fall downward! / With its heroes slain, its men slain by Indra and Agni, / defeated, driven away, let it go to the farthest distance!

20.48.s: tām indrāgnī hatavīrāṃ hatapūruṣāṃ parājitāṃ praṇuttāṃ yatīm anvākśītām | parājita etv asāv āmuṣyāyaṇo amuṣyāḥ putraḥ ||
20.48.d: ताम् इन्द्राग्नी हतवीरां हतपूरुषां पराजितां प्रणुत्तां यतीम् अन्वाक्शीताम् । पराजित एत्व् असाव् आमुष्यायणो अमुष्याः पुत्रः ॥
20.48.m: It, with its heroes slain, its men slain by Indra and Agni, / defeated, driven away as it goes— / defeated let yonder son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a mother, go!

20.48.s: asnā vyakta etu | aghaṃ hi raṇyetv asāv āmuṣyāyaṇo amuṣyāḥ putraḥ ||
20.48.d: अस्ना व्यक्त एतु । अघं हि रण्येत्व् असाव् आमुष्यायणो अमुष्याः पुत्रः ॥
20.48.m: Smeared with blood let him go! / Let evil indeed delight in him, yonder son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a mother!

20.48.s: aghapratīko aghenainaṃ vidhyāmaḥ | abhūtyā enaṃ pāśe sitvā duṣvapnyena saṃ sṛjya mṛtyor vyātta āsann api dadhāmi ||
20.48.d: अघप्रतीको अघेनैनं विध्यामः । अभूत्या एनं पाशे सित्वा दुष्वप्न्येन सं सृज्य मृत्योर् व्यात्त आसन्न् अपि दधामि ॥
20.48.m: Face-to-face with evil, with evil we pierce him! / Having bound him in the snare of ruin, / having joined [him] with evil dreaming, / I place [him] into the wide-open mouth of Death!

20.49.s: sṛjāmy āpa uśatīr upemāḥ saṃrarāṇāḥ payasā saṃ babhūvuḥ | datto asmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadrā apāṃ prati prati gṛhṇātv enāḥ ||
20.49.d: सृजाम्य् आप उशतीर् उपेमाः संरराणाः पयसा सं बभूवुः । दत्तो अस्मभ्यं द्रविणेह भद्रा अपां प्रति प्रति गृह्णात्व् एनाः ॥
20.49.m: I release these waters, desiring [them]; / consenting, they have united with milk. / Giving us wealth here, fortunate ones, / may [the lord] of waters receive these individually!

20.49.s: uc chrayasva bahur bhava svena mahasā yava | pṛṇīhi sarvā pātrāṇi mā tvā divyāśanir vadhīt ||
20.49.d: उच् छ्रयस्व बहुर् भव स्वेन महसा यव । पृणीहि सर्वा पात्राणि मा त्वा दिव्याशनिर् वधीत् ॥
20.49.m: Rise up, become abundant / through your own greatness, O barley! / Fill all the vessels; / let not the heavenly thunderbolt strike you!

20.49.s: āśṛṇvantaṃ yavaṃ devaṃ yatra tvācchāvadāmasi | tad uc chrayasva dyaur iva samudra ivaidhy akṣitaḥ ||
20.49.d: आशृण्वन्तं यवं देवं यत्र त्वाच्छावदामसि । तद् उच् छ्रयस्व द्यौर् इव समुद्र इवैध्य् अक्षितः ॥
20.49.m: When we address you, / the barley, a listening god, / then rise up like the sky; / be inexhaustible like the ocean!

20.49.s: akṣitās ta upasado akṣitāḥ santu rāśayaḥ | pṛṇanto akṣitāḥ santv attāraḥ santv akṣitāḥ ||
20.49.d: अक्षितास् त उपसदो अक्षिताः सन्तु राशयः । पृणन्तो अक्षिताः सन्त्व् अत्तारः सन्त्व् अक्षिताः ॥
20.49.m: Inexhaustible be your attendances, / inexhaustible let the heaps be, / inexhaustible let those who fill be, / inexhaustible let the eaters be!

20.49.s: sakṛd yad dyaur ajāyata sakṛd bhūmir ajāyata | sakṛd yaḥ pṛśniyā dugdhaṃ tad anyo nānu jāyate mā tvānu jani kaś cana ||
20.49.d: सकृद् यद् द्यौर् अजायत सकृद् भूमिर् अजायत । सकृद् यः पृश्निया दुग्धं तद् अन्यो नानु जायते मा त्वानु जनि कश् चन ॥
20.49.m: When once the sky was born, / once the earth was born, / what was once milked from Pṛśni, / no other is born after that; / let no one be born after you!

20.49.s: iṣvagram iṣuyāvanaṃ maṇiṃ kṛṇve sumaṅgalam | sa mā śaravyābhyaḥ pātu divānaktaṃ ca jīvase ||
20.49.d: इष्वग्रम् इषुयावनं मणिं कृण्वे सुमङ्गलम् । स मा शरव्याभ्यः पातु दिवानक्तं च जीवसे ॥
20.49.m: An arrow-point that wards off arrows, / an amulet of good fortune I make. / May it protect me from arrow-shots / by day and by night, in order that I may live!

20.49.s: pratiṣṭhito 'si brahmaṇā jambhayāmasi tvā vayam | apāmārgeṇa vidvalā idaṃ tvāpa mṛjmahe yuvantaṃ kṣipantaṃ jahi ||
20.49.d: प्रतिष्ठितो ऽसि ब्रह्मणा जम्भयामसि त्वा वयम् । अपामार्गेण विद्वला इदं त्वाप मृज्महे युवन्तं क्षिपन्तं जहि ॥
20.49.m: You are firmly established through sacred formulation; / we crush you. / With the apāmārga plant, O wise one, / we wipe this off you. / Slay the one who attacks, who hurls [missiles]!

20.49.s: śīrṇaṃ ta etan na kṣutaṃ ta etat saṃkṣutaṃ duḥkṣutaṃ tubhyam astu | rudrāśaniṣ ṭe jaghanena grīvā indra iva vṛtraṃ vajreṇa hantu ||
20.49.d: शीर्णं त एतन् न क्षुतं त एतत् संक्षुतं दुःक्षुतं तुभ्यम् अस्तु । रुद्राशनिष् टे जघनेन ग्रीवा इन्द्र इव वृत्रं वज्रेण हन्तु ॥
20.49.m: Broken is this of yours, not sneezed is this of yours; / let all sneezing and bad sneezing be for you! / May Rudra's thunderbolt strike your neck from behind, / as Indra struck Vṛtra with his vajra!

20.49.s: anuhavaṃ parihavaṃ parivādaṃ parikṣavam | savyermaṃ riktakumbhāṃ parā tāṃ savitaḥ suva ||
20.49.d: अनुहवं परिहवं परिवादं परिक्षवम् । सव्येर्मं रिक्तकुम्भां परा तां सवितः सुव ॥
20.49.m: The responsive call, the adverse call, / the reproach, the sneezing around, / the left-handed one, the woman with an empty pot— / banish them far away, O Savitṛ!

20.49.s: apapāpaṃ parikṣavaṃ puṇyaṃ bhakṣīmahi kṣavam | śivā te pāpanāsikāṃ parṇakaś cābhi mehatām ||
20.49.d: अपपापं परिक्षवं पुण्यं भक्षीमहि क्षवम् । शिवा ते पापनासिकां पर्णकश् चाभि मेहताम् ॥
20.49.m: Sneezing around that has evil removed, / an auspicious sneeze may we enjoy! / Auspicious for you / […] and may Parṇaka urinate upon [it]!

20.50.s: abhi tvā pañcaśākhena hastenādhāṃ sahīyasā | yathā na vidviṣāvahai na vibhavāva kadā cana ||
20.50.d: अभि त्वा पञ्चशाखेन हस्तेनाधां सहीयसा । यथा न विद्विषावहै न विभवाव कदा चन ॥
20.50.m: I place [my hand] over you with a five-branched, / most mighty hand, / so that we two shall not hate each other, / nor ever be separated!

20.50.s: cākravākaṃ saṃvananam asyasya svaṃkaram | amuṃ svaṃ kṛṇotu me yam ahaṃ kāmaye priyam ||
20.50.d: चाक्रवाकं संवननम् अस्यस्य स्वंकरम् । अमुं स्वं कृणोतु मे यम् अहं कामये प्रियम् ॥
20.50.m: The winning-charm of the cakravāka bird, / an appropriator belonging to this one— / let it make that one mine, / the dear one whom I desire!

20.50.s: yat kakṣīvāṃ saṃvananaṃ cyavanaś cakra āsuraḥ | tad vāṃ kṛṇomi dampatī saṃ priyau bhavataṃ yuvam ||
20.50.d: यत् कक्षीवां संवननं च्यवनश् चक्र आसुरः । तद् वां कृणोमि दम्पती सं प्रियौ भवतं युवम् ॥
20.50.m: The winning-charm which Kakṣīvant / and Cyavana the Asura made, / that I make for you two, O couple! / Become dear to one another, you two!

20.50.s: yathā saṃyuktau pakṣiṇau saṃpriyau carato mṛgau | evā saṃyuktau brahmaṇā saṃpriyau bhavataṃ yuvam ||
20.50.d: यथा संयुक्तौ पक्षिणौ संप्रियौ चरतो मृगौ । एवा संयुक्तौ ब्रह्मणा संप्रियौ भवतं युवम् ॥
20.50.m: As two birds joined together, / as two deer move about, dear to each other, / so, joined together by the sacred formulation, / become dear to one another, you two!

20.50.s: prehi pra hara pādāv ā gṛhebhyaḥ svastaye | kapiñjala pradakṣiṇaṃ śatapatrābhi no vada ||
20.50.d: प्रेहि प्र हर पादाव् आ गृहेभ्यः स्वस्तये । कपिञ्जल प्रदक्षिणं शतपत्राभि नो वद ॥
20.50.m: Go forward, step out with both feet / towards the houses, for well-being! / O kapiñjala bird, speaking auspiciously on the right, / hundred-feathered one, call out to us!

20.50.s: bhadraṃ vada dakṣiṇato bhadram uttarato vada | bhadraṃ purastān no vada bhadraṃ paścāt kapiñjala ||
20.50.d: भद्रं वद दक्षिणतो भद्रम् उत्तरतो वद । भद्रं पुरस्तान् नो वद भद्रं पश्चात् कपिञ्जल ॥
20.50.m: Call out good fortune from the south, / call out good fortune from the north, / call out good fortune to us from the front, / good fortune from behind, O kapiñjala!

20.50.s: śunaṃ vada dakṣiṇataḥ śunam uttarato vada | śunaṃ purastān no vada śunaṃ paścāt kapiñjala ||
20.50.d: शुनं वद दक्षिणतः शुनम् उत्तरतो वद । शुनं पुरस्तान् नो वद शुनं पश्चात् कपिञ्जल ॥
20.50.m: Call out prosperity from the south, / call out prosperity from the north, / call out prosperity to us from the front, / prosperity from behind, O kapiñjala!

20.50.s: yauvanāni mahayasi jigyuṣām iva dundubhiḥ | kapiñjala pradakṣiṇaṃ śatapatrābhi no vada ||
20.50.d: यौवनानि महयसि जिग्युषाम् इव दुन्दुभिः । कपिञ्जल प्रदक्षिणं शतपत्राभि नो वद ॥
20.50.m: You magnify youthful powers / like a drum of the victorious. / O kapiñjala bird, speaking auspiciously on the right, / hundred-feathered one, call out to us!

20.51.s: ut tabhnāmi gavāṃ kṣīram ud rathaṃ rathavāhanam | ut tabdhā asmākaṃ vīrā mayi gāvaś ca gopatau ||
20.51.d: उत् तभ्नामि गवां क्षीरम् उद् रथं रथवाहनम् । उत् तब्धा अस्माकं वीरा मयि गावश् च गोपतौ ॥
20.51.m: I support the milk of the cows, / upward [I hold] the chariot and the chariot-stand. / Supported are our heroes, / and the cows are with me, the lord of cows.

20.51.s: ut tvā stabhnātu savitā devo agnir un mitrāvaruṇāv aśvinobhā | sarvān sapatnān avadhīr yugena viśāṃ patir upasattaidhy atra ||
20.51.d: उत् त्वा स्तभ्नातु सविता देवो अग्निर् उन् मित्रावरुणाव् अश्विनोभा । सर्वान् सपत्नान् अवधीर् युगेन विशां पतिर् उपसत्तैध्य् अत्र ॥
20.51.m: May god Savitṛ support you upward, and Agni, / upward both Mitra and Varuṇa, and the two Aśvins! / You have slain all co-wives with the yoke; / as lord of the clans, sit down here to be served!

20.51.s: tvaṃ hi rudra vaśinī nirniṣe tvaṃ deveṣūta mānuṣeṣu | yad īśāno nayasi yac ca haṃsy asmākam astu pitṛṣu svadhāvat ||
20.51.d: त्वं हि रुद्र वशिनी निर्निषे त्वं देवेषूत मानुषेषु । यद् ईशानो नयसि यच् च हंस्य् अस्माकम् अस्तु पितृषु स्वधावत् ॥
20.51.m: For you, O Rudra, / are among the gods and among men. / What you as ruler guide, and what you slay, / let that be ours among the fathers, accompanied by svadhā!

20.51.s: vāyav ā rundhi no mṛgān asmabhyaṃ mṛgayadbhyaḥ | sa no nediṣṭham ā kṛdhi vāto hi raśanākṛtaḥ ||
20.51.d: वायव् आ रुन्धि नो मृगान् अस्मभ्यं मृगयद्भ्यः । स नो नेदिष्ठम् आ कृधि वातो हि रशनाकृतः ॥
20.51.m: O Vāyu, pen in the wild animals for us, / for us who are hunting! / Bring them nearest to us, / for the wind is made the tether!

20.51.s: ud asurya ud u yakṛt sthāma gacchatu te punaḥ | yato nilayate yakṛt tat prastambham ājatu | memaṃ pṛthupravartane jaghanastambhinaṃ karaḥ ||
20.51.d: उद् असुर्य उद् उ यकृत् स्थाम गच्छतु ते पुनः । यतो निलयते यकृत् तत् प्रस्तम्भम् आजतु । मेमं पृथुप्रवर्तने जघनस्तम्भिनं करः ॥
20.51.m: Up with the divine power, up let the liver / go back to your proper place! / From where the liver hides away, / drive that obstruction forth! / Do not make him stiff in the thighs, / O wide-turning one!

20.51.s: yā pārśve saṃtanoti hṛdayaṃ jihvayā saha | tāṃ tvaṃ devi pṛthivi hikkām arasāṃ kṛdhi ||
20.51.d: या पार्श्वे संतनोति हृदयं जिह्वया सह । तां त्वं देवि पृथिवि हिक्काम् अरसां कृधि ॥
20.51.m: The hiccup that stretches across the ribs, / the heart along with the tongue, / that hiccup, O goddess, / do you render powerless!

20.51.s: yadāsyāḥ srakve dahed yadā mūrdhānam agninā | athaiṣā dasyūnāṃ dāsī putthagi ni layiṣyate ||
20.51.d: यदास्याः स्रक्वे दहेद् यदा मूर्धानम् अग्निना । अथैषा दस्यूनां दासी पुत्थगि नि लयिष्यते ॥

20.51.s: aharahar balim itye haranto 'śvāyeva tiṣṭhate ghāsam agne | rāyaṣpoṣeṇa sam iṣā madanto 'gne mā te prativeśā riṣāma ||
20.51.d: अहरहर् बलिम् इत्ये हरन्तो ऽश्वायेव तिष्ठते घासम् अग्ने । रायष्पोषेण सम् इषा मदन्तो ऽग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम ॥
20.51.m: Day by day bringing tribute to him who goes, / as fodder to a standing horse, O Agni, / delighting with nourishment, with wealth and prospering— / O Agni, as your neighbors let us not suffer harm!

20.52.s: rātriṃrātrim aprayāmaṃ bharanto 'śvāyeva tiṣṭhate ghāsam asmai | rāyaspoṣeṇa sam iṣā madanto mā te agne prativeśā riṣāma ||
20.52.d: रात्रिंरात्रिम् अप्रयामं भरन्तो ऽश्वायेव तिष्ठते घासम् अस्मै । रायस्पोषेण सम् इषा मदन्तो मा ते अग्ने प्रतिवेशा रिषाम ॥
20.52.m: Night by night bringing [tribute] without ceasing, / as fodder to this standing horse, / delighting with nourishment, with wealth and prospering— / O Agni, as your neighbors let us not suffer harm!

20.52.s: āgna āyūṃṣi pavasvā suvorjam iṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
20.52.d: आग्न आयूंषि पवस्वा सुवोर्जम् इषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥
20.52.m: O Agni, clarify life-spans for us, / impel vigor and nourishment to us! / Drive misfortune far away!

20.52.s: trīṇy āyūṃṣi tava jātavedas tisro vyuṣṭīr uṣasas te agne | tisras te tanvo devasaṃśitās tābhir naḥ pāhi sadam apramādam ||
20.52.d: त्रीण्य् आयूंषि तव जातवेदस् तिस्रो व्युष्टीर् उषसस् ते अग्ने । तिस्रस् ते तन्वो देवसंशितास् ताभिर् नः पाहि सदम् अप्रमादम् ॥
20.52.m: Three are your life-spans, O Jātavedas, / three your beamings of the dawn, O Agni; / three are your bodies— / with them protect us always without remiss!

20.52.s: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhi na uta dvitīyayā | pāhi gīrbhis tisṛbhir ūrjāṃpate pāhi catasṛbhir vaso ||
20.52.d: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाहि न उत द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस् तिसृभिर् ऊर्जांपते पाहि चतसृभिर् वसो ॥
20.52.m: Protect us, O Agni, with the first; / protect us also with the second; / protect with three songs of praise, O lord of vigor; / protect with four, O Vasu!

20.52.s: samīcī māhanī pātām āyuṣmatyā ṛco mā chitsi | tanūpāt sāmno vasuvidaṃ lokam anu carāṇi ||
20.52.d: समीची माहनी पाताम् आयुष्मत्या ऋचो मा छित्सि । तनूपात् साम्नो वसुविदं लोकम् अनु चराणि ॥
20.52.m: May the two united [verses] protect! / May I not be cut off from the long-lived verse! / May I follow / the world of the sāman!

20.52.s: bhagehy arvāṅ upa mām iha tvaṃ mado nāmāsi mayi mādayāmum | surā ta ekam abhavaj janitram agner adhi jāto 'si brahmaṇā tejasā ca ||
20.52.d: भगेह्य् अर्वाङ् उप माम् इह त्वं मदो नामासि मयि मादयामुम् । सुरा त एकम् अभवज् जनित्रम् अग्नेर् अधि जातो ऽसि ब्रह्मणा तेजसा च ॥
20.52.m: O Bhaga, come hither towards me here! / You are named 'intoxication'; exhilarate that one toward me! / Liquor became your one place of origin; / you are born from Agni through sacred formulation and fiery splendor.

20.52.s: sahānayā praviśehāntarā mām | viśanty ehi praviśanty ehy ā mā viśa pra mā viś opa tvā hvaya upa mā hvayasva | nariṣṭā nāma vā asi ||
20.52.d: सहानया प्रविशेहान्तरा माम् । विशन्त्य् एहि प्रविशन्त्य् एह्य् आ मा विश प्र मा विश् ओप त्वा ह्वय उप मा ह्वयस्व । नरिष्टा नाम वा असि ॥
20.52.m: Enter here within me together with this woman! / Entering one, come! Penetrating one, come! / Enter into me, penetrate into me! / I call you, call me! / Indeed, you are uninjured by name.

20.52.s: yathāpaḥ pravatā yanti yathā māsā aharjaram | evā mā brahmacāriṇo dhātar ā yantu sarvadā ||
20.52.d: यथापः प्रवता यन्ति यथा मासा अहर्जरम् । एवा मा ब्रह्मचारिणो धातर् आ यन्तु सर्वदा ॥
20.52.m: As waters flow downward, / as the months into the consumer of days, / so let Vedic students / come to me at all times, O Dhātṛ!

20.52.s: ā ganta mā riṣaṇyata prastotāro māpa sthāta sumanyavaḥ | dṛḍhāso amariṣṇavo māvapiṣyavaḥ ||
20.52.d: आ गन्त मा रिषण्यत प्रस्तोतारो माप स्थात सुमन्यवः । दृढासो अमरिष्णवो मावपिष्यवः ॥
20.52.m: Come hither, do not come to harm, / O prastotṛ chanters, do not stand aloof, well-disposed ones! / Firm, not subject to harm, not failing.

20.53.s: dhātā te hastam agrahīt savitā hastam agrahīt | mitras tvam asi dharmaṇ agnir ācāryas tava ||
20.53.d: धाता ते हस्तम् अग्रहीत् सविता हस्तम् अग्रहीत् । मित्रस् त्वम् असि धर्मण् अग्निर् आचार्यस् तव ॥
20.53.m: Dhātṛ has taken your hand; / Savitṛ has taken your hand. / You are Mitra by sacred law; / Agni is your teacher.

20.53.s: agner brahmacāry asi mama brahmacāry asi | prajāpatiṣ ṭvā gopāyatu devāya tvā savitre pari dadāmi svasti caratād ihāsau ||
20.53.d: अग्नेर् ब्रह्मचार्य् असि मम ब्रह्मचार्य् असि । प्रजापतिष् ट्वा गोपायतु देवाय त्वा सवित्रे परि ददामि स्वस्ति चरताद् इहासौ ॥
20.53.m: You are a Vedic student, / my Vedic student are you. / May Prajāpati guard you! / I entrust you to god Savitṛ; / let yonder one live safely here!

20.53.s: viśvam asi viśvapate sarvam asi sarvapate | taṃ tvāsau devāya tvā savitre pari dadāmi svasti caratān mayi ||
20.53.d: विश्वम् असि विश्वपते सर्वम् असि सर्वपते । तं त्वासौ देवाय त्वा सवित्रे परि ददामि स्वस्ति चरतान् मयि ॥
20.53.m: You are everything, O lord of everything; / you are all, O lord of all. / As such, I entrust you, yonder one, to god Savitṛ; / let him live safely with me!

20.53.s: samāvavartti viṣṭhito jigīṣur viśveṣāṃ kāmaś caratām ihāstu | viśvā dveṣāṃsi duritā hitv ā yantv anuvratā savitur daivyasya ||
20.53.d: समाववर्त्ति विष्ठितो जिगीषुर् विश्वेषां कामश् चरताम् इहास्तु । विश्वा द्वेषांसि दुरिता हित्व् आ यन्त्व् अनुव्रता सवितुर् दैव्यस्य ॥
20.53.m: He who is desirous of victory, having stepped forth, turns back; / let the desire of all moving beings be here! / Having abandoned all enmities and misfortunes, / let them come, devoted to the divine Savitṛ!

20.53.s: ā no hasto akṛtāgāt svargaḥ punar aitu tanvā saṃvidānaḥ | prāṇena tejasā harasā balena mitro asmān varuṇa ubhayatas pātu ||
20.53.d: आ नो हस्तो अकृतागात् स्वर्गः पुनर् ऐतु तन्वा संविदानः । प्राणेन तेजसा हरसा बलेन मित्रो अस्मान् वरुण उभयतस् पातु ॥
20.53.m: Our blameless hand has reached heaven; / let it return, uniting with the body! / With breath, fiery splendor, heat, and strength, / may Mitra and Varuṇa protect us from both sides!

20.53.s: yat kāma kāmayamānā idaṃ kṛṇmasi te haviḥ | tan naḥ sarvaṃ sam ṛdhyatām athaitasya haviṣo vīhi svāhā ||
20.53.d: यत् काम कामयमाना इदं कृण्मसि ते हविः । तन् नः सर्वं सम् ऋध्यताम् अथैतस्य हविषो वीहि स्वाहा ॥
20.53.m: With whatever desire desiring, / we prepare this oblation for you, / let all that succeed for us! / Then enjoy this oblation, svāhā!

20.53.s: yad varco dyāvāpṛthivyor atho yad āñjana tvayi | tena sucakṣā varcasy ahaṃ bhūyāsam āñjana ||
20.53.d: यद् वर्चो द्यावापृथिव्योर् अथो यद् आञ्जन त्वयि । तेन सुचक्षा वर्चस्य् अहं भूयासम् आञ्जन ॥
20.53.m: The splendor which is in heaven and earth, / and what, O ointment, is in you, / through that may I, O ointment, / be possessed of good sight and full of splendor!

20.53.s: yady aspṛṣi śliṣṭaṃ yadi vā svapnayānuśliṣṭam | āśliṣṭāvacchedanam asy abhidṛṣṭavīryam ||
20.53.d: यद्य् अस्पृषि श्लिष्टं यदि वा स्वप्नयानुश्लिष्टम् । आश्लिष्टावच्छेदनम् अस्य् अभिदृष्टवीर्यम् ॥
20.53.m: If I have touched anything clinging, / or if [it was] clung to in a dream, / you are the severer of what has clung, / of observed virility.

20.53.s: ava vār iva vārivā ava varṣaṃ girer iva | ava jyām iva dhanvano hṛdi śliṣṭaṃ chinadmi te ||
20.53.d: अव वार् इव वारिवा अव वर्षं गिरेर् इव । अव ज्याम् इव धन्वनो हृदि श्लिष्टं छिनद्मि ते ॥
20.53.m: Down like water from a water-carrier, / down like rain from a mountain, / down like the bowstring from a bow, / I cut off what has clung to your heart.

20.53.s: yat te hṛdi śliṣṭaṃ yac ca śliṣṭaṃ purītati | madhye pṛṣṭīnāṃ yac chliṣṭaṃ tat pārṣṇyāva chinadmi te ||
20.53.d: यत् ते हृदि श्लिष्टं यच् च श्लिष्टं पुरीतति । मध्ये पृष्टीनां यच् छ्लिष्टं तत् पार्ष्ण्याव छिनद्मि ते ॥
20.53.m: What has clung to your heart, / and what has clung in the pericardium, / what has clung in the midst of your ribs, / that I cut off from you with the heel.

20.54.s: yat te śliṣṭaṃ kloma karṇeṣu yac ca śiśne sanābhyām | indras tad abravīd bhiṣak pārṣṇir āśliṣṭāvacchedanī ||
20.54.d: यत् ते श्लिष्टं क्लोम कर्णेषु यच् च शिश्ने सनाभ्याम् । इन्द्रस् तद् अब्रवीद् भिषक् पार्ष्णिर् आश्लिष्टावच्छेदनी ॥
20.54.m: What has clung to your lungs, in [your] ears, / and what [has clung] to the penis, to the navel— / Indra, the physician, declared that: / the heel is the severer of what has clung.

20.54.s: eṣā vai duḥsahā nāma pārṣṇir āśliṣṭāvacchedanī | idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasyāśliṣṭāṃ pra cchinadmi ||
20.54.d: एषा वै दुःसहा नाम पार्ष्णिर् आश्लिष्टावच्छेदनी । इदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्यामुष्याः पुत्रस्याश्लिष्टां प्र च्छिनद्मि ॥
20.54.m: This indeed is called irresistible, / the heel, severer of what has clung. / Here I cut forth what has clung to so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so, son of so-and-so.

20.54.s: vipaścit puccham ābharat tad viṣṇuḥ punar ābharat | tad agninā manasā saṃvidānaṃ pumāṃsam asyai putraṃ dhehi svāhā ||
20.54.d: विपश्चित् पुच्छम् आभरत् तद् विष्णुः पुनर् आभरत् । तद् अग्निना मनसा संविदानं पुमांसम् अस्यै पुत्रं धेहि स्वाहा ॥
20.54.m: The wise one brought the tail; / that Viṣṇu brought back. / That, agreeing with Agni with [his] mind, / place a male son for her! Svāhā!

20.54.s: vipaścit puccham ā bhara yarjjarahastā cittyā | yathāsyāḥ putro jāyatā abhibhūr ṇo vipaścitā ||
20.54.d: विपश्चित् पुच्छम् आ भर यर्ज्जरहस्ता चित्त्या । यथास्याः पुत्रो जायता अभिभूर् णो विपश्चिता ॥
20.54.m: O wise one, bring near the tail / with intention, / so that a son may be born to her, / our overcomer by wisdom.

20.54.s: apehīto vipaścit tvaṃ pumān ayaṃ janiṣyate | pumān puṃso adhi saṃbhūtaḥ sa pumān eva jāyatām ||
20.54.d: अपेहीतो विपश्चित् त्वं पुमान् अयं जनिष्यते । पुमान् पुंसो अधि संभूतः स पुमान् एव जायताम् ॥
20.54.m: Go away from here, you wise one! / This male will be born; / a male generated from a male, / let him be born as a male indeed!

20.54.s: bhadrāya karṇaḥ krośatu bhadrāyākṣi vi vepatām | parā duṣvapnyaṃ suva yad bhadraṃ tan na ā suva ||
20.54.d: भद्राय कर्णः क्रोशतु भद्रायाक्षि वि वेपताम् । परा दुष्वप्न्यं सुव यद् भद्रं तन् न आ सुव ॥
20.54.m: Let the ear cry out for good fortune; / let the eye flutter for good fortune. / Drive away bad dreaming; / what is good, drive that hither to us!

20.54.s: akṣivepaṃ duṣvapnyam ārtiṃ puruṣareṣiṇīm | tad asmad aśvinā yuvam apriye prati muñcatam ||
20.54.d: अक्षिवेपं दुष्वप्न्यम् आर्तिं पुरुषरेषिणीम् । तद् अस्मद् अश्विना युवम् अप्रिये प्रति मुञ्चतम् ॥
20.54.m: The eye-flutter, bad dreaming, / the distress that harms people, / fasten that, O two Aśvins, / upon the unfriendly one away from us!

20.54.s: yat pārśvād uraso me aṅgādaṅgād avavepate | aśvinā puṣkarasrajā tasmān naḥ pātam aṃhasaḥ ||
20.54.d: यत् पार्श्वाद् उरसो मे अङ्गादङ्गाद् अववेपते । अश्विना पुष्करस्रजा तस्मान् नः पातम् अंहसः ॥
20.54.m: What flutters from my side, from my chest, / from limb after limb, / O two Aśvins with lotus-garlands, / protect us from that distress!

20.54.s: yadīd amṛtakāmyāghaṃ ripram upeyima | andhaśroṇa iva hīyatāṃ mā no nv āgād aghaṃ yataḥ ||
20.54.d: यदीद् अमृतकाम्याघं रिप्रम् उपेयिम । अन्धश्रोण इव हीयतां मा नो न्व् आगाद् अघं यतः ॥
20.54.m: If desiring immortality we have approached evil […] / [and] defilement, / like a blind and lame man let it be left behind; / may evil not now come to us from where [it arose]!

20.54.s: ariprā āpo apa ripram asmat | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tasmin duṣvapnyam ā sṛjāmi ||
20.54.d: अरिप्रा आपो अप रिप्रम् अस्मत् । यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस् तस्मिन् दुष्वप्न्यम् आ सृजामि ॥
20.54.m: Undefiled are the waters; [carry] defilement away from us! / Whoever hates us, whom we hate, / upon him I cast bad dreaming.

20.54.s: payo me kloma karṇeṣu payo me vīrudho dadhan | payo me sṛṣṭā deveṣu payo me dadhat ||
20.54.d: पयो मे क्लोम कर्णेषु पयो मे वीरुधो दधन् । पयो मे सृष्टा देवेषु पयो मे दधत् ॥
20.54.m: Milk in my lungs, in [my] ears; / milk may the plants place in me; / milk created for me among the gods, / milk may they place in me!

20.55.s: adarśi gātuvittamo yasmin vratāny ādadhuḥ | upo ṣu jātam āryasya vardhanaṃ somaṃ gacchantu no giraḥ ||
20.55.d: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन् व्रतान्य् आदधुः । उपो षु जातम् आर्यस्य वर्धनं सोमं गच्छन्तु नो गिरः ॥
20.55.m: The best finder of the way, / in whom they have placed the vows; / unto the newly born enhancer of the Aryan, / unto Soma let our songs go!

20.55.s: pra daivodāso agnir devām̐ acchā na majmanā | anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi ||
20.55.d: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर् देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि ॥
20.55.m: Forth [goes] Agni, the son of Divodāsa, / toward the gods, as it were, by his might; / along mother earth he has rolled, / he has stood on the ridge of the firmament.

20.55.s: yasmād rejanti kṛṣṭayaś carkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ | sahasrasā medhasātāv iva tman āgniṃ dhībhir duvasyata ||
20.55.d: यस्माद् रेजन्ति कृष्टयश् चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसा मेधसाताव् इव त्मन् आग्निं धीभिर् दुवस्यत ॥
20.55.m: From whom the peoples tremble, / as he performs memorable deeds, / winning a thousand as in the prize of contest, by himself, / [we praise] Agni with thoughts.

20.55.s: ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||
20.55.d: आ प्यायस्व सम् एतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
20.55.m: Swell up! Let virile power gather for you / from every side, O Soma! / Be [present] in the gathering of the prize!

20.55.s: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhir aṃśubhiḥ | bhavā naḥ sumnayuḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
20.55.d: आ प्यायस्व मदिन्तम सोम विश्वेभिर् अंशुभिः । भवा नः सुम्नयुः सखा वृधे ॥
20.55.m: Swell up, most exhilarating / Soma, with all stalks! / Be for us a well-disposed companion for growth!

20.55.s: saṃ te payāṃsi sam u yantu vajāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyāny abhimātiṣāhaḥ | āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsy uttamāni dhiṣva ||
20.55.d: सं ते पयांसि सम् उ यन्तु वजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्य् अभिमातिषाहः । आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्य् उत्तमानि धिष्व ॥
20.55.m: Let milks gather for you, and prizes gather; / let virile powers [gather], you conqueror of enemies! / Swelling up for immortality, O Soma, / place the highest fames in heaven!

20.55.s: vidma tvā vayaṃ somaṃ rājānaṃ ye tvā na viduḥ | teṣāṃ cakṣuṣā śrotreṇa prāṇena prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanenā pyāyasva | eṣā ta oṣadhīs tayā tvam ā pyāyasva ||
20.55.d: विद्म त्वा वयं सोमं राजानं ये त्वा न विदुः । तेषां चक्षुषा श्रोत्रेण प्राणेन प्रजया पशुभिर् गृहैर् धनेना प्यायस्व । एषा त ओषधीस् तया त्वम् आ प्यायस्व ॥
20.55.m: We know you, Soma / the king, whom they do not know. / With their eye, with [their] ear, / with [their] breath, with offspring, with cattle, with houses, with wealth, swell up! / This is your plant; / through it do you swell up!

20.55.s: āpīno asmān āpyāyac cakṣuṣā śrotreṇa prāṇena prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena ||
20.55.d: आपीनो अस्मान् आप्यायच् चक्षुषा श्रोत्रेण प्राणेन प्रजया पशुभिर् गृहैर् धनेन ॥
20.55.m: May the swollen one make us swell / with eye, with ear, with breath, with offspring, with cattle, with houses, with wealth!

20.55.s: yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ | indro yad vṛtrahā veda tat satyaṃ cittamohanam ||
20.55.d: यद् वेद राजा वरुणो वेद देवो बृहस्पतिः । इन्द्रो यद् वृत्रहा वेद तत् सत्यं चित्तमोहनम् ॥
20.55.m: What King Varuṇa knows, / what the god Bṛhaspati knows, / what Indra the slayer of Vṛtra knows, / that is the true confounder of the mind.

20.55.s: śarveṇa nīlaśikhaṇḍena bhavena marutāṃ pitrā | virūpākṣeṇa babhruṇā vācaṃ vadiṣyato hatāḥ ||
20.55.d: शर्वेण नीलशिखण्डेन भवेन मरुतां पित्रा । विरूपाक्षेण बभ्रुणा वाचं वदिष्यतो हताः ॥
20.55.m: By Śarva of the dark-blue tuft, / by Bhava, the father of the Maruts, / by the diverse-eyed, tawny one, / slain are they who are about to speak a word!

20.56.s: etad yad anyatra jigāṃsatha yad anyatra vivīṣatha | tad vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tad vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
20.56.d: एतद् यद् अन्यत्र जिगांसथ यद् अन्यत्र विवीषथ । तद् वश् चित्तम् अमूमुहं तद् वश् चित्तम् अनीनशम् ॥
20.56.m: This which is elsewhere, / which is elsewhere, / therewith I have confounded your mind, / therewith I have destroyed your mind.

20.56.s: asti vai pathāṃ niṣkuṭaṃ nadīnāṃ ca niraṅkaśam | tena vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tena vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
20.56.d: अस्ति वै पथां निष्कुटं नदीनां च निरङ्कशम् । तेन वश् चित्तम् अमूमुहं तेन वश् चित्तम् अनीनशम् ॥
20.56.m: There is indeed a turning-place of paths / and an unhindered course of rivers; / therewith I have confounded your mind, / therewith I have destroyed your mind.

20.56.s: yāni vaḥ sapta cetāṃsy aṣṭau yāni manāṃsi ca | tad vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tad vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
20.56.d: यानि वः सप्त चेतांस्य् अष्टौ यानि मनांसि च । तद् वश् चित्तम् अमूमुहं तद् वश् चित्तम् अनीनशम् ॥
20.56.m: What seven intentions of yours [there are], / and what eight thoughts, / therewith I have confounded your mind, / therewith I have destroyed your mind.

20.56.s: indreṇa medinā yuj āgninā jātavedasā | tena vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tena vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
20.56.d: इन्द्रेण मेदिना युज् आग्निना जातवेदसा । तेन वश् चित्तम् अमूमुहं तेन वश् चित्तम् अनीनशम् ॥
20.56.m: With Indra as an ally, a companion, / with Agni Jātavedas, / therewith I have confounded your mind, / therewith I have destroyed your mind.

20.56.s: pratīcīnāṃ vo abhy adhām aśvam ivāśvābhidhānyā | kṛṇve vo māmake vaśe pador upānahau yathā ||
20.56.d: प्रतीचीनां वो अभ्य् अधाम् अश्वम् इवाश्वाभिधान्या । कृण्वे वो मामके वशे पदोर् उपानहौ यथा ॥
20.56.m: I have bound you backward, / as a horse with a horse-halter. / I make you in my own control, / like two sandals on the feet.

20.56.s: devānāṃ saṃsad asi devānāṃ yātur asi | yayā tanvā brahma jinvasi tayā mā jinva ||
20.56.d: देवानां संसद् असि देवानां यातुर् असि । यया तन्वा ब्रह्म जिन्वसि तया मा जिन्व ॥
20.56.m: You are the assembly of the gods; / you are the sorcerer of the gods. / With whichever body you enliven the sacred formulation, / with that enliven me!

20.56.s: roce mā prakāśe mā kaṇvā vidan mā gamaya | anu mā budhyantām ||
20.56.d: रोचे मा प्रकाशे मा कण्वा विदन् मा गमय । अनु मा बुध्यन्ताम् ॥
20.56.m: In brightness me, in illumination me, / the Kaṇvas have found; make me attain [it]! / Let them perceive me!

20.56.s: vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedur indraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ | apa dhvāntam ūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣur mumugdhy asmān nidhayeva baddhān ||
20.56.d: वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुर् इन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः । अप ध्वान्तम् ऊर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर् मुमुग्ध्य् अस्मान् निधयेव बद्धान् ॥
20.56.m: Fair-winged birds approached Indra, / the Priyamedha ṛṣis, beseeching: / "Uncover the darkness from our eye, / release us like those bound in a snare!"

20.56.s: apsu jātasya mahatas pary aśmanaḥ | svayaṃjātasya śociṣo 'dbhiḥ parvata nāśaya ||
20.56.d: अप्सु जातस्य महतस् पर्य् अश्मनः । स्वयंजातस्य शोचिषो ऽद्भिः पर्वत नाशय ॥
20.56.m: From the great stone born in the waters, / from the self-born flame, / with waters, O mountain, make [it] vanish!

20.56.s: uttodinīṃ śimidvatī durgayonir vyadvarām | mṛgām̐ anu pra pātaya marīcīr anu nāśaya ||
20.56.d: उत्तोदिनीं शिमिद्वती दुर्गयोनिर् व्यद्वराम् । मृगाँ अनु प्र पातय मरीचीर् अनु नाशय ॥
20.56.m: The piercing one, the powerful one, / of difficult womb, the piercing insect, / make it fly away along with the deer, / make it vanish along with the rays!

20.56.s: aśvasyāsnaḥ saṃpatitā parṇe te vasatiṣ kṛtā | asṛk patatriṇām asi jahi vāmūn pra bādhama ||
20.56.d: अश्वस्यास्नः संपतिता पर्णे ते वसतिष् कृता । असृक् पतत्रिणाम् असि जहि वामून् प्र बाधम ॥
20.56.m: Fallen together, / in a leaf your dwelling has been made. / You are the blood of winged birds; / slay those two, we drive [them] away!

20.56.s: asṛkto adhi jāto 'si parṇe te sadanaṃ kṛtam | āṇḍaṃ patatriṇām asi jahi vāmūn pra bādhama ||
20.56.d: असृक्तो अधि जातो ऽसि पर्णे ते सदनं कृतम् । आण्डं पतत्रिणाम् असि जहि वामून् प्र बाधम ॥
20.56.m: You are born from blood; / in a leaf your seat has been made. / You are the egg of winged birds; / slay those two, we drive [them] away!

20.56.s: yathā gardabho vivartanād vidhūya vipalāyate | evāsau palāyatām amuṣmād adhy āyataḥ ||
20.56.d: यथा गर्दभो विवर्तनाद् विधूय विपलायते । एवासौ पलायताम् अमुष्माद् अध्य् आयतः ॥
20.56.m: Just as a donkey, shaking himself, / flees from the rolling-place, / so let that one flee, / stretching away from that one!

20.57.m: You are gain, you are the gainer; may I gain!
You are action, you are the doer; may I act!
You are acquisition, you are the acquirer; may I acquire!
You are prosperity, you are prosperous; may I prosper!

20.57.s: bhūr asi subhūr asi subhūr nāmāsi ||
20.57.d: भूर् असि सुभूर् असि सुभूर् नामासि ॥
20.57.m: You are being, you are good being, you are named good being.
You are the middle, best ray of Prajāpati.

20.57.s: bhūtaye tvā vittaye tvā paśūnāṃ tvā vittaya ā dadhāmi ||
20.57.d: भूतये त्वा वित्तये त्वा पशूनां त्वा वित्तय आ दधामि ॥
20.57.m: For prosperity I place you, for acquisition I place you, for acquisition of cattle I place you.
Agni is the conveyor, the conveyor is Agni.

20.57.s: bṛhaspates tvā mukhena yācāmi sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣe adabdhena tvā cakṣuṣāvekṣe ||
20.57.d: बृहस्पतेस् त्वा मुखेन याचामि सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रतीक्षे अदब्धेन त्वा चक्षुषावेक्षे ॥
20.57.m: With Bṛhaspati's mouth I beg you; / with the Sun's eye I watch for you; / with an undeceived eye I look upon you.

20.57.s: ayuto 'ham ayuto ma ātmā ayutaṃ me cakṣur ayutaṃ me śrotram ayuto me prāṇo ayuto me 'pāno ayuto 'haṃ sarvaḥ ||
20.57.d: अयुतो ऽहम् अयुतो म आत्मा अयुतं मे चक्षुर् अयुतं मे श्रोत्रम् अयुतो मे प्राणो अयुतो मे ऽपानो अयुतो ऽहं सर्वः ॥
20.57.m: Unharmed am I, unharmed is my self; / unharmed is my eye, unharmed is my ear; / unharmed is my in-breath, unharmed is my out-breath, unharmed am I entirely.

20.57.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūta ā rabhe ||
20.57.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रसूत आ रभे ॥
20.57.m: At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the two Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, impelled, I take hold [of you].
With Agni's mouth I eat you, with Bṛhaspati's mouth.
I seat you in the belly of Indra, in the stomach of Varuṇa.

20.57.s: yo agnir nṛmaṇā nāma brāhmaṇeṣu praviṣṭaḥ ||
20.57.d: यो अग्निर् नृमणा नाम ब्राह्मणेषु प्रविष्टः ॥
20.57.m: Which Agni, named manly-minded, has entered into the brahmins—

20.57.s: tasminn etat suhutam astu prāśitaṃ tan mā mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman ||
20.57.d: तस्मिन्न् एतत् सुहुतम् अस्तु प्राशितं तन् मा मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन् ॥
20.57.m: in him let this eaten [food] be well-offered; / do not harm me in the highest firmament!

20.58.s: veda vai te takman nāma viśvaso nāma vā asi | asamaratho nāma te pitā hārṣī nāma takman te mātā śimidā nāma te svasā ||
20.58.d: वेद वै ते तक्मन् नाम विश्वसो नाम वा असि । असमरथो नाम ते पिता हार्षी नाम तक्मन् ते माता शिमिदा नाम ते स्वसा ॥
20.58.m: I know indeed your name, O fever; / Viśvasa indeed is your name; / Asamaratha is your father's name; / Hārṣī is your mother's name, O fever; / Śimidā is your sister's name.
"Go to the mountain" is the seventh [verse].

20.58.s: asurās tvod ava bharan samudrād adhi māyayā | tad āsrāvasya bheṣajaṃ tad u rogam anīnaśat ||
20.58.d: असुरास् त्वोद् अव भरन् समुद्राद् अधि मायया । तद् आस्रावस्य भेषजं तद् उ रोगम् अनीनशत् ॥
20.58.m: The Asuras brought you up / from the ocean by creative power; / that was the remedy for discharge, / and that destroyed the disease.

20.58.s: rogasthānam asṛksthānam atho āsrāvabheṣajam | babhror aśvasya vāreṇ āpi nahyāmi tā aham ||
20.58.d: रोगस्थानम् असृक्स्थानम् अथो आस्रावभेषजम् । बभ्रोर् अश्वस्य वारेण् आपि नह्यामि ता अहम् ॥
20.58.m: The place of disease, the place of blood, / and the remedy for discharge, / with a hair of a tawny horse, / those I tie shut.

20.58.s: yan me daṇḍo vāpāti dīkṣayā tapasā saha | tam ahaṃ punar ā dade punar indraḥ punar bhagaḥ | punar me brahmaṇaspatir brahma jīvitavā adāt ||
20.58.d: यन् मे दण्डो वापाति दीक्षया तपसा सह । तम् अहं पुनर् आ ददे पुनर् इन्द्रः पुनर् भगः । पुनर् मे ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् ब्रह्म जीवितवा अदात् ॥
20.58.m:
If my staff has fallen away,
together with consecration [and] ascetic heat,
that I take back again;
again Indra, again Bhaga,
again Brahmaṇaspati has given
the sacred prayer for me to live.

20.58.s: itthād ulūkāpa tanvan uttānapādam arbhakaḥ | sa me premāṇam ā vahad apa dveṣaḥ parā vahat ||
20.58.d: इत्थाद् उलूकाप तन्वन् उत्तानपादम् अर्भकः । स मे प्रेमाणम् आ वहद् अप द्वेषः परा वहत् ॥
20.58.m:
Thus the owl away…
the small child with outstretched feet.
May he bring affection to me;
may he carry hatred far away.

20.58.s: yathā bāṇaḥ susaṃśitaḥ parāpataty āśumat | evā mūtrasya te dhārā parā patati ketumat ||
20.58.d: यथा बाणः सुसंशितः परापतत्य् आशुमत् । एवा मूत्रस्य ते धारा परा पतति केतुमत् ॥
20.58.m:
Just as a well-sharpened arrow
flies off swiftly,
so may the stream of your urine
fly off visibly.

20.58.s: yathā madhu madhukṛtaḥ saṃbharanti madhāv adhi | evā me madhumad vaco deveṣu puruṣeṣu ca ||
20.58.d: यथा मधु मधुकृतः संभरन्ति मधाव् अधि । एवा मे मधुमद् वचो देवेषु पुरुषेषु च ॥
20.58.m:
Just as the honey-makers bring together
honey onto honey,
even so [may] my speech [be] honeyed
among the gods and among men.

20.58.s: dīrghāyutvāya tapase mahyā ariṣṭatātaye | suparṇo mahyam abravīd etad utsaktabheṣajam etat puliśabheṣajam ||
20.58.d: दीर्घायुत्वाय तपसे मह्या अरिष्टतातये । सुपर्णो मह्यम् अब्रवीद् एतद् उत्सक्तभेषजम् एतत् पुलिशभेषजम् ॥

20.59.s: paiśir mātā peśiḥ pitā paiśeyaḥ peśyā hataḥ | addhā kṛtasya brahmaṇā vṛścikasyārasaṃ viṣam ||
20.59.d: पैशिर् माता पेशिः पिता पैशेयः पेश्या हतः । अद्धा कृतस्य ब्रह्मणा वृश्चिकस्यारसं विषम् ॥
20.59.m:
Paiśi is the mother, Peśi the father;
Paiśeya has been slain by Peśī.
Truly made powerless by sacred prayer
is the scorpion's poison.

20.59.s: nir hvayāmi parṇasādān nir ut pucchād u te viṣam | bhūmis ta ucyate mātā tasyai te nama it sṛja ||
20.59.d: निर् ह्वयामि पर्णसादान् निर् उत् पुच्छाद् उ ते विषम् । भूमिस् त उच्यते माता तस्यै ते नम इत् सृज ॥
20.59.m:
I call out your poison from the leaf-settler,
and out from the tail.
Earth is called your mother;
pay homage to her!

20.59.s: kim u danta āmayati kim abhūd upaveśanam | āpo nir asyatā krimim agade kṛṇutā hanū ||
20.59.d: किम् उ दन्त आमयति किम् अभूद् उपवेशनम् । आपो निर् अस्यता क्रिमिम् अगदे कृणुता हनू ॥
20.59.m:
Does the tooth ache?
What diarrhea was there?
O Waters, throw out the worm!
Make the two jaws free of disease!

20.59.s: yatra bhūmyā anāmṛtaṃ divi candramasi śritam | vidvām̐ ahaṃ tatra manye māhaṃ pautram aghaṃ ni gām ||
20.59.d: यत्र भूम्या अनामृतं दिवि चन्द्रमसि श्रितम् । विद्वाँ अहं तत्र मन्ये माहं पौत्रम् अघं नि गाम् ॥
20.59.m:
Where on earth the imperishable [drink] is,
resting in heaven, in the moon—
knowing that, I think:
may I not fall into misfortune concerning sons!

20.59.s: yat te susīme hṛdayam ado vai tat prajāpatau | vedāma tasya te vayaṃ māhaṃ pautram aghaṃ ni gām ||
20.59.d: यत् ते सुसीमे हृदयम् अदो वै तत् प्रजापतौ । वेदाम तस्य ते वयं माहं पौत्रम् अघं नि गाम् ॥

20.59.s: yat suvarṇāyā hṛdayaṃ pṛthivyām adhi niṣṭhitam | vedāhaṃ tasyās tan nāma māhaṃ pautram aghaṃ ni gām ||
20.59.d: यत् सुवर्णाया हृदयं पृथिव्याम् अधि निष्ठितम् । वेदाहं तस्यास् तन् नाम माहं पौत्रम् अघं नि गाम् ॥
20.59.m:
The heart of the golden one
which is established on the earth,
I know that name of hers;
(may I not fall into misfortune concerning sons).

20.59.s: agner hṛdayam asi vidyut tat tvā tathā veda | māhaṃ pautram aghaṃ ni gām ||
20.59.d: अग्नेर् हृदयम् असि विद्युत् तत् त्वा तथा वेद । माहं पौत्रम् अघं नि गाम् ॥

20.59.s: prajā ime prajāpata indrāgnī śarma yacchatam | yathāhaṃ jyog ihāsāni prajānām adhipā vaśī ||
20.59.d: प्रजा इमे प्रजापत इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम् । यथाहं ज्योग् इहासानि प्रजानाम् अधिपा वशी ॥
20.59.m:
O Prajāpati, these offspring—
O Indra and Agni, grant protection,
so that I may be here for a long time,
a commanding overlord of offspring.

20.59.s: yāṃ prajām avidām ady ātmanaḥ parinirmitām | āyuṣmatīṃ tanūkṛtāṃ tām̐ agne jarase naya ||
20.59.d: यां प्रजाम् अविदाम् अद्य् आत्मनः परिनिर्मिताम् । आयुष्मतीं तनूकृतां ताँ अग्ने जरसे नय ॥
20.59.m:
The offspring which we have found today,
[…] completely fashioned,
long-lived, having a fine body,
lead them, O Agni, to old age.

20.59.s: indra ivāsāni sāsahir agnir iva jyotiṣā bṛhan | sūrya iva viśvataḥ pratyak samudra iva duṣṭaraḥ ||
20.59.d: इन्द्र इवासानि सासहिर् अग्निर् इव ज्योतिषा बृहन् । सूर्य इव विश्वतः प्रत्यक् समुद्र इव दुष्टरः ॥
20.59.m:
May I be victorious like Indra,
great with light like Agni,
facing everywhere like the sun,
difficult to cross like the ocean.

20.60.s: ṛcaṃ sāma yad aprākṣaṃ havir ojo yajur balam | etaṃ mā tasmān mā hiṃsīd vedaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śacīpate ||
20.60.d: ऋचं साम यद् अप्राक्षं हविर् ओजो यजुर् बलम् । एतं मा तस्मान् मा हिंसीद् वेदः पृष्टः शचीपते ॥
20.60.m:
The verse, the chant that I have asked about,
the oblation, the power, the sacrificial formula, the strength—
from that do not [separate] me…
O lord of might, questioned regarding sacred knowledge.

20.60.s: ud bhare dyāvāpṛthivī sahauṣadhībhiḥ | gṛhṇāmi prajāṃ nir apaḥ sṛjāmi ||
20.60.d: उद् भरे द्यावापृथिवी सहौषधीभिः । गृह्णामि प्रजां निर् अपः सृजामि ॥
20.60.m:
I lift up Heaven and Earth together with the plants;
I take hold of offspring, I release the waters.

20.60.s: mā na āpo medhāṃ mā brahma pra mathiṣṭana | suṣyadā yūyaṃ syandadhvam upahūto 'haṃ sumedhā varcasvī ||
20.60.d: मा न आपो मेधां मा ब्रह्म प्र मथिष्टन । सुष्यदा यूयं स्यन्दध्वम् उपहूतो ऽहं सुमेधा वर्चस्वी ॥
20.60.m:
O Waters, do not churn away our wisdom,
nor our sacred prayer!
Flow on, you!
Invoked am I, wise and radiant.

20.60.s: mā no medhāṃ mā no dīkṣāṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭa yat tapaḥ | śivā naḥ sarva āyuṣa āpo bhavantu mātaraḥ ||
20.60.d: मा नो मेधां मा नो दीक्षां मा नो हिंसिष्ट यत् तपः । शिवा नः सर्व आयुष आपो भवन्तु मातरः ॥
20.60.m:
Do not injure our wisdom, nor our consecration,
nor our ascetic heat that is there!
Kindly through all of life,
may the Waters be our mothers.

20.60.s: iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām asmin goṣṭhe viśvabhṛto janitrīḥ | agniṃ kulāyam upa saṃviśantīr jānantu naḥ payasā ghṛtena ||
20.60.d: इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् अस्मिन् गोष्ठे विश्वभृतो जनित्रीः । अग्निं कुलायम् उप संविशन्तीर् जानन्तु नः पयसा घृतेन ॥
20.60.m:
May offspring of all forms rest here,
mothers supporting all in this cattle-pen;
entering Agni's nest,
may they recognize us with milk and ghee.

20.60.s: rantaya stha ramataya stha mayi śrita stha mayi śrayadhvam | manotā nāma stha grāmyā apsaraso veda vo vittam ā mā viśata ||
20.60.d: रन्तय स्थ रमतय स्थ मयि श्रित स्थ मयि श्रयध्वम् । मनोता नाम स्थ ग्राम्या अप्सरसो वेद वो वित्तम् आ मा विशत ॥

20.60.s: śarva nīlaśikhaṇḍa vīra karmaṇikarmaṇi | imām asya prāśaṃ jahi yenedaṃ vivadāmahe ||
20.60.d: शर्व नीलशिखण्ड वीर कर्मणिकर्मणि । इमाम् अस्य प्राशं जहि येनेदं विवदामहे ॥
20.60.m:
O Śarva with dark-blue crest,
O hero in every deed,
strike down this claimant's plea of his
by which we dispute here.

20.60.s: tṛtīyakaṃ vitṛtīyaṃ sadandiṃ takmānam uta rājayakṣmam | yathā śakra unmumoca tṛtīyakam evāhaṃ tad un muñcāmi tṛtīyakaṃ tam asyām oṣadhyāṃ badhnāmi ||
20.60.d: तृतीयकं वितृतीयं सदन्दिं तक्मानम् उत राजयक्ष्मम् । यथा शक्र उन्मुमोच तृतीयकम् एवाहं तद् उन् मुञ्चामि तृतीयकं तम् अस्याम् ओषध्यां बध्नामि ॥
20.60.m:
The tertian, the semi-tertian
fever, and consumption—
just as the powerful one unloosed the tertian,
so do I unloose that;
that tertian I bind
on this plant.

20.60.d: आध्वस्तपक्ष्णे बृहते पथे ऽहम् अकरं नमः ॥
20.60.m:
To the broad path
with dust-covered eyelashes I have paid homage.

20.60.d: इन्द्राय त्विषीमते पथे ऽहम् अकरं नमः ॥
20.60.m: To the brilliant path, to Indra, I have paid homage.

20.61.m:
To the path, the tiger
with teeth on both jaws, I have paid homage.

20.61.s: namas te pathye revati svasti mā parā ṇaya svasti punar ā naya | atho svasti nas kṛdhi jīvā jyotir aśīmahi ||
20.61.d: नमस् ते पथ्ये रेवति स्वस्ति मा परा णय स्वस्ति पुनर् आ नय । अथो स्वस्ति नस् कृधि जीवा ज्योतिर् अशीमहि ॥
20.61.m:
Homage to you, Pathyā, the wealthy one!
Lead me away in safety,
bring me back again in safety!
And make safety for us;
alive, may we attain the light!

20.61.s: āmanasaṃ yajāmahe satyaprāśaṃ purohitam | taṃ devaṃ prathamaṃ yaje yo 'mum āmanasaṃ karat ||
20.61.d: आमनसं यजामहे सत्यप्राशं पुरोहितम् । तं देवं प्रथमं यजे यो ऽमुम् आमनसं करत् ॥
20.61.m:
We sacrifice to
the domestic priest whose plea is true;
I sacrifice first to that god
who will make that one favorable in mind.

20.61.s: āmanaska devak āroruvatka devaka | arvāg avastaraṃ kṛdhi yam ahaṃ kāmaye priyam ||
20.61.d: आमनस्क देवक् आरोरुवत्क देवक । अर्वाग् अवस्तरं कृधि यम् अहं कामये प्रियम् ॥
20.61.m:
O favorable little god,
O roaring little god,
make the one whom I love as dear
turn toward here, down lower.

20.61.s: ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣo ayaṃ no vasuvittamaḥ | asyopasadye mā riṣām āyaṃ rakṣatu naḥ prajām ||
20.61.d: अयं नो अग्निर् अध्यक्षो अयं नो वसुवित्तमः । अस्योपसद्ये मा रिषाम् आयं रक्षतु नः प्रजाम् ॥

20.61.s: asmin sahasraṃ puṣyāsm aidhamānāḥ sve gṛhe | imaṃ sam indhiṣīmahy āyuṣmantaḥ suvarcasaḥ ||
20.61.d: अस्मिन् सहस्रं पुष्यास्म् ऐधमानाः स्वे गृहे । इमं सम् इन्धिषीमह्य् आयुष्मन्तः सुवर्चसः ॥
20.61.m:
In him may we thrive a thousandfold,
thriving in our own house;
may we kindle him,
long-lived, full of splendor.

20.61.s: śuddhavālā kṛṣṇaphalā kabrūr balāsabheṣajī | śuktivalgasya nāśanī devī dadātu bheṣajam ||
20.61.d: शुद्धवाला कृष्णफला कब्रूर् बलासभेषजी । शुक्तिवल्गस्य नाशनी देवी ददातु भेषजम् ॥
20.61.m:
Pure-tailed, black-fruited,
brown, healing balāsa,
destroyer of the pearl-white speck,
may the goddess give the remedy.

20.61.s: aśvattho devasadanas tṛtīyasyām ito divi | tatra lohitavṛkṣo jātaḥ śigruḥ kṣiptabheṣajaḥ ||
20.61.d: अश्वत्थो देवसदनस् तृतीयस्याम् इतो दिवि । तत्र लोहितवृक्षो जातः शिग्रुः क्षिप्तभेषजः ॥
20.61.m:
The aśvattha is the seat of the gods
in the third heaven from here;
there the red tree is born,
the śigru, the remedy for wounds.

20.61.s: na tatra bhavo hanti na śarva iṣum asyati | yatra tvaṃ deva tumburo parvateṣu virohasi ||
20.61.d: न तत्र भवो हन्ति न शर्व इषुम् अस्यति । यत्र त्वं देव तुम्बुरो पर्वतेषु विरोहसि ॥
20.61.m:
There Bhava does not slay,
nor does Śarva shoot his arrow,
where you, divine tumburu,
grow on the mountains.

20.61.s: kṛṣyām anyo vi rohati girer anyo 'dhi pakṣasi | trātārau śaśvatām imāv ā gantāṃ śigrutumburū ||
20.61.d: कृष्याम् अन्यो वि रोहति गिरेर् अन्यो ऽधि पक्षसि । त्रातारौ शश्वताम् इमाव् आ गन्तां शिग्रुतुम्बुरू ॥
20.61.m:
One grows in cultivated land,
the other on the flank of the mountain;
the two saviors of eternal [men],
may they come here!

20.62.s: yāvat parṇaṃ yāvat phalaṃ yāvanto adhyṛkṣarāḥ | tāvantaḥ śuṣmās tumburos tad u te viṣadūṣaṇam ||
20.62.d: यावत् पर्णं यावत् फलं यावन्तो अध्यृक्षराः । तावन्तः शुष्मास् तुम्बुरोस् तद् उ ते विषदूषणम् ॥
20.62.m:
As much as the leaf, as much as the fruit,
as many as are the thorns,
so many are the powers of the tumburu;
that indeed is your destroyer of poison.

20.62.s: rudra jalāṣabheṣaj emaṃ rogam aśīsamo jalāṇiti ||
20.62.d: रुद्र जलाषभेषज् एमं रोगम् अशीसमो जलाणिति ॥
20.62.m:
O Rudra with cooling remedy,
[…] you have appeased this disease,
healingly.

20.62.s: asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād idam urv antarikṣam | ṛṣabhasyeva kanikladato hṛdayaṃ śamayāmi te ||
20.62.d: अस्थाद् द्यौर् अस्थात् पृथिव्य् अस्थाद् इदम् उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् । ऋषभस्येव कनिक्लदतो हृदयं शमयामि ते ॥
20.62.m:
Heaven has stood still, earth has stood still,
this wide intermediate space has stood still;
as of a bellowing bull,
I appease your heart.

20.62.s: saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ māsau rohiṇī divaḥ | saṃ māyam agniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu me ||
20.62.d: सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः सं मासौ रोहिणी दिवः । सं मायम् अग्निः सिञ्चतु प्रजया च धनेन च दीर्घम् आयुष् कृणोतु मे ॥

20.62.s: naktaṃ harī mṛgayete divā suparṇarohitau | bhavāya ca śarvāya c obhābhyām akaraṃ namaḥ ||
20.62.d: नक्तं हरी मृगयेते दिवा सुपर्णरोहितौ । भवाय च शर्वाय च् ओभाभ्याम् अकरं नमः ॥
20.62.m:
At night two bays hunt,
by day two ruddy eagles;
to Bhava and to Śarva,
to both I have paid homage.

20.62.s: namo bhavāya namaḥ śarvāya namaḥ kumāraśatrave | namo nīlaśikhaṇḍāya namaḥ sabhāprapādine ||
20.62.d: नमो भवाय नमः शर्वाय नमः कुमारशत्रवे । नमो नीलशिखण्डाय नमः सभाप्रपादिने ॥
20.62.m:
Homage to Bhava, homage to Śarva,
homage to the enemy of children,
homage to the dark-blue-crested one,
homage to the one who enters the assembly!

20.62.s: yasya harī aśvatarau gardabhāv abhitaḥsarau | tasmai nīlaśikhaṇḍāya namaḥ sabhāprapādine ||
20.62.d: यस्य हरी अश्वतरौ गर्दभाव् अभितःसरौ । तस्मै नीलशिखण्डाय नमः सभाप्रपादिने ॥
20.62.m:
Whose two bays are mules,
two donkeys running around—
to that dark-blue-crested one,
homage to the one who enters the assembly!

20.62.s: asāv eti śiśumāro asāv eti pulīkayā | kumāraśatro va roh odakaṃ parivācanam ||
20.62.d: असाव् एति शिशुमारो असाव् एति पुलीकया । कुमारशत्रो व रोह् ओदकं परिवाचनम् ॥
20.62.m:
Yonder goes the dolphin,
yonder it goes with the pulīkā.
O enemy of children, mount down
into the water, the reservoir!

20.62.s: yathedam abhram arbhakaṃ parjanyād apa śīyate | evā me aśvinā mukhād abhīly apa śīyatām ||
20.62.d: यथेदम् अभ्रम् अर्भकं पर्जन्याद् अप शीयते । एवा मे अश्विना मुखाद् अभील्य् अप शीयताम् ॥
20.62.m:
Just as this small cloud
is shed from the rain-cloud,
even so from my face, O Aśvins,
let the facial blemish be shed away.

20.62.s: abhīli naśyetaḥ paras tvacaṃ me mābhi mimlapaḥ | agastyasya brahmaṇ ābhīlīṃ nāśayāmasi ||
20.62.d: अभीलि नश्येतः परस् त्वचं मे माभि मिम्लपः । अगस्त्यस्य ब्रह्मण् आभीलीं नाशयामसि ॥
20.62.m:
O facial blemish, perish far away from here;
do not wither my skin!
With Agastya's sacred prayer
we destroy the facial blemish.

20.63.s: sesicām upatvacāṃ nāśay ā pururūpād abhīlyaṃ mukhāt ||
20.63.d: सेसिचाम् उपत्वचां नाशय् आ पुरुरूपाद् अभील्यं मुखात् ॥
20.63.m:
The moist skin-diseases destroy
[…] the facial blemish from the multiform face.

20.63.s: yan me kṛtād apriyād āruroha malaṃ mukham | apāṃ vāta iva śīpālaṃ sūryas tad apa lumpatu ||
20.63.d: यन् मे कृताद् अप्रियाद् आरुरोह मलं मुखम् । अपां वात इव शीपालं सूर्यस् तद् अप लुम्पतु ॥
20.63.m:
The stain that mounted upon my face
from an unpleasant deed done [to me],
as the wind [clears] water-moss from the waters,
let the sun break it away.

20.63.s: apa me 'bhīlī patatv abhraṃ vātahṛtaṃ yathā | ā mā suvarṇaṃ gacchatu subhāgam astu me mukham ||
20.63.d: अप मे ऽभीली पतत्व् अभ्रं वातहृतं यथा । आ मा सुवर्णं गच्छतु सुभागम् अस्तु मे मुखम् ॥

20.63.s: yathā sūryasyopodaye hiraṇyaṃ pratirocate | evā me aśvinā mukhaṃ suvarṇaṃ prati rocatām ||
20.63.d: यथा सूर्यस्योपोदये हिरण्यं प्रतिरोचते । एवा मे अश्विना मुखं सुवर्णं प्रति रोचताम् ॥
20.63.m:
Just as gold shines out
at the rising of the sun,
even so, O Aśvins, may my face
shine out with golden beauty.

20.63.s: pra yad gāvo na bhūrṇayas tveṣā vayāṃsy akraman | ghnantu kṛṣṇām apa tvacaṃ subhāgam astu me mukham ||
20.63.d: प्र यद् गावो न भूर्णयस् त्वेषा वयांस्य् अक्रमन् । घ्नन्तु कृष्णाम् अप त्वचं सुभागम् अस्तु मे मुखम् ॥
20.63.m: When, like vehement cows, / the glittering birds have advanced, / let them strike away the black skin; / may my face be fortunate.

20.63.s: indreṇa preṣita ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
20.63.d: इन्द्रेण प्रेषित उलूका सं पचामि ते ॥
20.63.m: Sent by Indra, / O owl, I cook [it] together for you.

20.63.s: somena preṣita ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
20.63.d: सोमेन प्रेषित उलूका सं पचामि ते ॥
20.63.m: Sent by Soma, / O owl, I cook [it] together for you.

20.63.s: sūryeṇa preṣita ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
20.63.d: सूर्येण प्रेषित उलूका सं पचामि ते ॥
20.63.m: Sent by Sūrya, / O owl, I cook [it] together for you.
Sent by Bṛhaspati, / O owl, I cook [it] together for you.
Sent by Prajāpati, / O owl, I cook [it] together for you.
